question:
The scatterplot shows the relationship between x and y for the 9 data points in data set A. A quadratic model for the data in data set A can be written as y=0.07x2−0.06x+6.32. The graph of this model is shown in the xy-plane. The data point at x=0 was found to be the result of a recording error and was removed from data set A to create data set B , consisting of the remaining 8 data points. A quadratic model for the data in data set B can be written as y=ax2+bx+c. , where a ,b, and c are constants. If the quadratic models for data sets A and B are calculated in the same way, which of the following statements must be true? I.a>0.07
 II.c<6.32
explanations:
由图中可以看出，在x=0出的点为(0, 11)，y值较大，所以会将函数图像向上提，所以移走该点会减小函数在x=0时的值，即c小于6.32. II正确。
a的值决定了图像的弯曲程度。点(0, 11)靠近数据的中心。当中心的点比较高时，图像会因为要匹配中心的高度而变得更平缓。当移走(0, 11)后，曲线会更贴近x=-2, -1, 1, 2附近的点，所以会更弯曲，即a的值会更大。I正确。选C

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>k</mi><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>=</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>k</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>4</mn><mi>a</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>k</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>
In the given equation, a and k are constants, where <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>k</mi><mo>></mo><mn>4</mn><mi>a</mi></math>. The sum of the solutions to the equation is 3k+33. What is the value of a ?
explanations:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mtable columnspacing="1em" displaystyle="true" rowspacing="3pt"><mtr><mtd><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>k</mi><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>k</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>4</mn><mi>a</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>k</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mtd></mtr><mtr><mtd><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>k</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>k</mi><mo>−</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>k</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>4</mn><mi>a</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mtd></mtr><mtr><mtd><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>k</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>k</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>4</mn><mi>a</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mtd></mtr></mtable></math>
因此方程的两个解为k和2k-4a。所以解的和为3k-4a=3k+33。解出a=-8.25。

question:
Along with traditional Japanese forms of woodwork and weaving, sashiko embroidery was revived during the mingei (folk art) movement of the twentieth century. Sashiko’s functional origins as a mending technique and its use of motifs inspired by everyday life, such as tsuru (crane), reflect the principle that folk art should______ its form and themes from the lives of its creators.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
与传统的日本木工和编织形式一样，刺子绣在二十世纪的民艺运动中得到复兴。刺子绣作为一种修补技术的功能性起源，以及它使用受日常生活启发的图案（如鹤），体现了民艺应当从创作者的生活中 ______ 其形式和主题这一原则。
中文解析：
文本指出刺子绣的功能（修补技术）和图案（日常生活中的鹤）都来自创作者的生活，这与民艺的原则一致：形式和主题应“源于”生活。选项 B“derive”意为“获取、源自”，最符合语境。

question:
In the field of supply chain management, the spread of automation technologies has ______the redistribution of human labor. Offloading some repetitive and simple tasks to machines has enabled workers to shift their time and energy toward more nuanced and sophisticated tasks that require human expertise.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在供应链管理领域，自动化技术的普及已经 ______ 了人类劳动力的重新分配。将一些重复性和简单的任务转移给机器，使工人能够将时间和精力转向需要人类专业知识的更精细、更复杂的任务。
中文解析：
文本指出自动化使工人能够从简单任务转向复杂任务，这意味着自动化“促进”了劳动力的重新分配。选项 B“facilitated”最符合这一逻辑。accredited → 官方认可的、认证的 / 给予信任或授权；decelerated → 减速、放慢

question:
A student is writing a research paper on the history of irrigation in the state of California, situating the development of the Dodge Reservoir (created in Lassen County, California, in 1893) in a larger historical context. The student claims that innovation in irrigation techniques was driven in part by the climate in some parts of the state.

Which quotation from a study of California agriculture best supports the student’s claim?
selections: A. “While the low humidity of Southern California’s desert areas makes irrigation a requirement if agriculture is to be a success there, the relatively high humidity in the northern parts of the state makes such practices less necessary.”
B. “The necessity of irrigation infrastructure in California today cannot be overstated, since it is the most common means of conveying water for agricultural use.”

C. “The irrigation system developed by the Hohokam people in the 7th century CE in what is now Arizona was simple but applied hydraulic engineering design features that are still used today in both Arizona and California.”

D. “ Competition for scarce water resources in Southern California inspired the development of sprinkler irrigation systems, a manner of irrigating that requires less use of water than traditional surface irrigation methods.”
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
一名学生正在撰写一篇关于加利福尼亚州灌溉历史的研究论文，将道奇水库（1893年在加州拉森县建成）的发展置于更大的历史背景中。该学生声称，灌溉技术的创新部分是由该州某些地区的气候所驱动的。
中文解析：
D选项正确，因为它体现了“资源稀缺推动技术创新”这一核心逻辑：南加州对稀缺水资源的竞争，直接催生了更节水的喷灌系统。虽然选项未明确写出“气候”二字，但在农业语境下，水资源稀缺的根本原因正是干旱气候，因此D最符合学生关于“气候驱动创新”的论点。其他选项要么只提气候而不提创新，要么与创新无关。

question:
From the little penguin to the North Atlantic right whale, a wide range of semiaquatic species have been found to share a common approach for saving energy when traveling long distances. To minimize both wave drag at the surface and the vertical distance to reach the surface to breathe, these air-breathing marine animals swim at depths around three times their body diameter. This finding has important implications for animal conservation efforts. For example, considering typical swim depths could help reduce the risk of boat strikes, which are a major threat to whales.

Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?
selections: A. To identify a shared trait across several species that makes the conservation of those species particularly challenging
B. To describe a general trend in the swim depths of certain species that explains why those species are more efficient swimmers than are other semiaquatic species
C. To summarize a theory that accounts for why most air-breathing marine animals swim at the same depth regardless of their size
D. To present a finding about the behavior of certain species that may help conservationists protect those species
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
从小蓝企鹅到北大西洋露脊鲸，人们发现各种各样的半水生物种在长距离移动时都采用一种共同的节能策略。为了最小化表面的波浪阻力以及到达水面呼吸的垂直距离，这些呼吸空气的海洋动物在约为自身体直径三倍的深度游泳。这一发现对动物保护工作具有重要意义。例如，考虑典型的游泳深度有助于减少船击风险，而船击是对鲸鱼的主要威胁。
中文解析：
文本首先介绍了一个关于半水生动物游泳深度的共同发现，然后用“This finding has important implications for animal conservation efforts”明确转向保护应用，并以船击为例说明。因此主要目的是呈现一个有助于保护工作的发现，选项 D 正确。选项 A 说该特征使保护“尤其具有挑战性”，与文本中“有助于减少风险”相反。

question:
The following text is from Mary Crow Dog’s 1990 autobiography Lakota Woman, written in collaboration with Richard Erdoes.
At the center of the old Sioux society was the tiyospaye, the extended family group, the basic hunting band, which included grandparents, uncles, aunts, in-laws, and cousins. The tiyospaye was like a warm womb cradling all within it. Kids were never alone, always fussed over by not one but several mothers, watched and taught by several fathers.
©1990 by Mary Crow Dog and Richard Erdoes

What does the text most strongly suggest about the function of the tiyospaye?
selections: A. It operated as a formal network for maintaining cultural practices.
B. It offered care and protection to all the members it included.
C. It functioned primarily as a way to organize hunting activities.
D. It served as the central authority for governing society.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
以下文字摘自 Mary Crow Dog 与 Richard Erdoes 合著的 1990 年自传《拉科塔女人》。
旧时苏族社会的核心是 tiyospaye，即大家庭群体，也是基本的狩猎群体，包括祖父母、叔伯、姑姨、姻亲及堂表亲。tiyospaye 如同一个温暖的子宫，庇护着其中的每一个人。孩子们从不孤单，总是被不止一个而是多个母亲疼爱，被多个父亲看护和教导。
中文解析：
文本将 tiyospaye 比作“温暖的子宫”，并具体描述孩子们有“多个母亲疼爱”“多个父亲看护和教导”，这些都强调其提供照顾和保护的功能。选项 B 准确概括了这一点。选项 C 虽提及“狩猎群体”，但文本更侧重照顾与保护，而非主要强调狩猎组织功能。

question:
Predating the European colonization of Canada, the Tahltan bear dog vanished due to interbreeding with dogs brought from Europe. In contrast, the Inuit dog persists as a distinct breed, and DNA testing confirms its descent from precolonial North American dogs. It also has genetic markers found in the dogs of East Asia but absent in those of Europe. That finding supports the theory that the precolonial breeds developed by Indigenous peoples descend from dogs that migrated from Asia in the last ice age. The Carolina dog, a yellow-coated breed native to rural pockets of the Southeastern United States, likely has such an origin too.

Which finding, if true, would most directly support the underlined claim?
selections: A. Additional DNA testing confirms that the Inuit dog and the Carolina dog share a rare set of genes not found in any East Asian breeds.
B. The Carolina dog carries a genetic marker that is not found in the dog populations of Europe but is present in the dog populations of East Asia.
C. Dogs in feral populations in the Southeastern United States have a set of genes also found in East Asian breeds imported in recent decades.
D. Identical genetic markers are identified in remains of both the Tahltan bear dog and a dog population it interbred with.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
早于欧洲殖民加拿大之前，塔特兰熊犬因与欧洲带来的狗杂交而消失。相比之下，因纽特犬作为一个独特的品种延续至今，DNA测试证实其是前殖民时代北美狗的后代。它还具有在东亚狗中发现、但在欧洲狗中不存在的遗传标记。这一发现支持了以下理论：由原住民培育的前殖民时代的品种，是上一个冰河时代从亚洲迁徙而来的狗的后代。卡罗来纳犬——一种黄毛品种，原产于美国东南部农村地区——很可能也有这样的起源。
中文解析：
正确答案是 B。文中论证的逻辑是：因纽特犬因具有“东亚有、欧洲无”的标记，从而支持其源于亚洲迁徙；同理，要支持卡罗来纳犬同样源于亚洲，就应提供证据表明它也具有“东亚有、欧洲无”的遗传标记。B选项正好提供了这一证据。

question:
The following text is adapted from Jhumpa Lahiri’s 2003 novel The Namesake. Gogol has recently begun working at an architecture firm in New York.
His contributions are incidental, and never fully his own: a stairwell, a skylight, a corridor, an air-conditioning duct. Still, he knows that each component of a building, however small, is nevertheless essential, and he finds it gratifying that after all his years of schooling, all his critics [reviews] and unbuilt projects, his efforts are to have some practical end.
©2003 by Jhumpa Lahiri

As used in the text, what does the word “end” most near mean?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
以下文字改编自茱帕·拉希里 2003 年的小说《同名人》。Gogol 最近开始在纽约一家建筑事务所工作。
他的贡献是辅助性的，且从不完全属于他自己：一段楼梯井、一个天窗、一条走廊、一根空调管道。尽管如此，他知道建筑的每个组成部分，无论多么微小，仍然是必不可少的，并且他感到欣慰的是，经过他多年的学业、所有的评论和未建成的项目之后，他的努力终将达成某种实际 _____。
©2003 by Jhumpa Lahiri
中文解析：
文中“his efforts are to have some practical end”指的是他的努力将产生某种“实际的结果”或“达成实际的目的”。选项 B“Purpose”（目的、结果）最符合这一语境。

question:
Highly Traveled Commercial Airline Routes in 2017—2018
A study of commercial airline routes that carried the greatest number of passengers in 2017 and 2018 shows that, in general, domestic routes (routes within a single country) carried many more passengers than international routes. However, a few international routes were so popular that they carried more travelers than some of the most highly traveled domestic routes, as can be seen when comparing the_______

Which choice most effectively uses data from the table to complete the example?
selections: A. number of passengers who traveled between Kuala Lumpur and Singapore in 2017 with the number who traveled that same route in 2018.
B. number of passengers who traveled between Kuala Lumpur and Singapore in 2018 with the number who traveled between Mexico City and Guadalajara during that same year.
C. distance between Mexico City and Guadalajara with the distance between Kuala Lumpu r and Singapore.
D. number of passengers who traveled between Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City in 2017 with the number who traveled between Hong Kong and Seoul-Incheon during that same year.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
一项关于 2017 年和 2018 年客运量最大的商业航线研究表明，总体而言，国内航线（单国内部航线）的乘客数量远高于国际航线。然而，少数国际航线非常受欢迎，其乘客数量甚至超过了一些客流量最大的国内航线，这一点可以通过比较 ______ 看出。
中文解析：
文本要说明的是：少数国际航线乘客数量超过了某些国内航线。表格中吉隆坡–新加坡（国际航线）2018 年乘客数为 4,490,463，而墨西哥城–瓜达拉哈拉（国内航线）2018 年乘客数为 3,170,177，前者确实高于后者。选项 B 直接比较了这两条航线 2018 年的乘客数，有效证明了这一观点。

question:
While some people believe they can reduce monthly air-conditioning costs simply by closing air registers in vacant rooms, this practice can actually reduce the____climate-control systems by creating internal pressure imbalances that restrict airflow across critical components and force motors to work harder.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
虽然有些人认为仅通过关闭空房间的通风口就可以降低每月的空调成本，但这种做法实际上会降低气候控制系统的 ______，因为它会造成内部压力不平衡，从而限制关键部件的气流，迫使电机更费力地工作。
中文解析：
文本指出关闭通风口会导致压力不平衡、气流受限、电机更费力，这些都会使系统运行效果变差，即降低“效率”。选项 B“efficiency of”最符合逻辑。

question:
Sparrows and other pest birds can cause damage to sweet cherries and other fruits grown on farms by pecking at them and spoiling them. Aware of some practical limitations of reflective elements and other common deterrents, Qing Chen et al. investigated the utility of an inexpensive, easily installed sonic bird repeller in a pear orchard. In one area the repeller emitted a sound continuously, while in another it emitted a sound only when triggered by a webcam linked to a neural network trained to recognize a pest bird’s presence. (A third area without a repeller was used as a control condition.) Chen et al. concluded that an intermittently active sonic repellent is more effective than one that is constantly active, as evidenced by the fact that _____

Which choice most effectively uses data from the graph to complete the assertion?
selections: A. the lowest rate of damage occurred in the area of the orchard where the repeller was not attached to a neural network.
B. the greatest rate of damage to the pears occurred in the area of the orchard where no repeller was used.
C. the rate of damage to the pears was approximately 7% in the area with the repeller attached to a neural network and approximately 13% in the area where no repeller was used.
D. the rate of damage to the pears was approximately 6% in the area with the repeller attached to a neural network and approximately 7% in the area with the repeller not attached to a neural network.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
“麻雀和其他害鸟会啄食并损坏农场种植的甜樱桃和其他水果。意识到反光元件和其他常见驱赶器的一些实际局限性后，Qing Chen 等人在梨园中研究了一种廉价、易于安装的声波驱鸟器的效用。在一个区域，驱赶器连续发出声音；在另一个区域，驱赶器仅在由连接到经过训练识别害鸟存在的神经网络的网络摄像头触发时才发出声音（第三个没有驱赶器的区域作为对照条件）。Chen 等人得出结论，间歇性主动的声波驱赶器比持续主动的驱赶器更有效，证据是 ______。”
中文解析：
正确答案是 D。该选项指出：连接神经网络的驱赶器（间歇性主动）区域的果实受损率约为 6%，而未连接神经网络的驱赶器（持续主动）区域的受损率约为 7%，说明间歇性主动驱赶器的受损率更低，从而支持“间歇性更有效”的结论。

question:
Wayang is an art form from Java, Indonesia, that uses shadow puppets, voice actors, and music to tell stories. As long ago as the ninth century, wayang artists began to learn from and teach puppet artists from other places, including India and Persia (present-day Iran). Today, wayang performances regularly add heroes and stories from ancient Indian and Persian tales. This suggests that wayang, as it is performed today, _____

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. is largely unchanged from how it was performed in the ninth century.
B. is more popular among the Javanese people than are other forms of storytelling.
C. focuses on the specifically Indonesian aspects of the art form.
D. includes elements from other cultures along with Javanese ones.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
Wayang 是印度尼西亚爪哇岛的一种艺术形式，利用皮影、配音演员和音乐来讲述故事。早在公元九世纪，wayang 艺术家就开始向包括印度和波斯（今伊朗）在内的其他地方的皮影艺术家学习并传授技艺。如今，wayang 表演经常加入来自古印度和波斯传说中的英雄和故事。这表明，今天表演的 wayang ______。
中文解析：
文本指出 wayang 从九世纪起就与其他文化（印度、波斯）交流学习，如今表演中也加入印度和波斯的英雄和故事。因此，wayang 包含了其他文化的元素。选项 D 准确概括了这一结论。选项 A、C 与文本中吸收外来元素的事实矛盾，选项 B 的“受欢迎程度”文本未提及。

question:
The 2024 movie Mean Girls, a remake of the 2004 cult classic, earned over $28 million during its first weekend in US theaters. One reason for its popularity is that the movie’s marketing team used the internet to introduce new viewers to the original story before the remake was released. The marketers uploaded the original film divided into 23 short segments to a social media site popular with teenagers. The entire film received at least 750,000 views in one day, and 100,000 people started following the “Mean Girls” social media account.

Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?
selections: A. To explain the success of advertising for the Mean Girls remake
B. To compare movie theaters in the United States to movie theaters in other countries
C. To praise the actors who starred in the original version of Mean Girls
D. To criticize the cost of making movies in the United States
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
2024 年电影《Mean Girls》是 2004 年经典 cult 电影的翻拍版，在美国影院上映首个周末票房收入超过 2800 万美元。其受欢迎的一个原因是，该电影的营销团队在翻拍版上映前利用互联网向新观众介绍原版故事。营销人员将原版电影分成 23 个小片段，上传到一个受青少年欢迎的社交媒体网站上。整部电影在一天内获得了至少 75 万次观看，并有 10 万人开始关注《Mean Girls》的社交媒体账号。
中文解析：
文本首先指出翻拍版《Mean Girls》首周末票房很高，然后解释其原因——营销团队通过社交媒体向新观众介绍原版故事，并用数据证明营销效果。因此，主要目的是“解释广告营销成功的原因”，选项 A 正确。

question:
Positive expressive writing is a writing technique intended to create positive mindsets through a focus on exploring and expressing thoughts and emotions such as optimism. Lauren Hoult and colleagues systematically reviewed multiple studies about different styles of positive expressive writing that included methods known as gratitude letter, three good things, and best possible self. They concluded that gratitude letter and best possible self showed the most consistent benefits for increasing optimism and fostering a positive mindset.

According to the text, which methods of positive expressive writing did Hoult and colleagues conclude were most consistently effective?
selections: A. Best possible self and fostering a positive mindset
B. Gratitude letter and three good things
C. Gratitude letter and best possible self
D. Best possible self and three good things
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
积极表达性写作是一种写作技巧，旨在通过专注于探索和表达乐观等想法与情绪来营造积极心态。Lauren Hoult 及其同事系统回顾了多项关于不同风格积极表达性写作的研究，这些写作风格包括所谓的“感恩信”、“三件好事”和“最好的自己”。他们得出结论：“感恩信”和“最好的自己”在提升乐观情绪和培养积极心态方面表现出最持续的好处。
中文解析：
本最后一句明确指出，Hoult 及其同事的结论是：“感恩信”和“最好的自己”这两种方法在提升乐观和积极心态方面效果最持续。

question:
Edmund Morris, noted for his three-volume chronicle of the life of Theodore Roosevelt, completed Edison, his biography of Thomas Edison, in 2019. The book covers important parts of its subject’s life, including Edison’s patent for a vote recorder, his creation of a carbon-filament electric light bulb, and his development of a rechargeable battery. However, it relates Edison’s life in reverse chronological order, an unusual approach about which reviewer Derek Thompson said, “Nothing is gained by [it], and much comprehension is lost.”

Which choice best describes the overall structure of the text?
selections: A. It identifies a biography, notes some events recounted in the biography, then presents a critical response to one particular quality of the biography.
B. It refers to two biographies, contrasts certain aspects of those biographies, then explains why critics generally preferred one biography to the other.
C. It presents the subject of a biography, describes some major developments in that subject's life, then. suggests that the biography's account of that life-made some careless omissions.
D. It describes a surprising feature of a biography, offers a summary of events in the subject’s life, and then quotes an expert who defends that feature.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
埃德蒙·莫里斯以他的三卷本西奥多·罗斯福传记而闻名，于 2019 年完成了他的托马斯·爱迪生传记《爱迪生》。这本书涵盖了其传主生平的重要部分，包括爱迪生的投票记录器专利、碳丝电灯泡的发明以及可充电电池的研发。然而，它以倒叙的时间顺序来讲述爱迪生的一生，这是一种不寻常的手法，评论家德里克·汤普森对此评价道：“这样做没有任何好处，反而损失了很多理解上的便利。”
中文解析：
文本结构为：1）指明传记《爱迪生》（Edison, his biography of Thomas Edison）；2）列举书中叙述的一些事件（专利、灯泡、电池）；3）通过“However”转折，指出其倒叙结构这一特质，并引用评论家的批评回应。选项 A 准确概括了这一结构。

question:
The following text is from Sarojini Naidu’s 1896 poem “Alabaster.”
Like this alabaster box whose art
Is frail as a cassia-flower, is my heart,
Carven with delicate dreams and wrought
With many a subtle and exquisite thought.

In the text, what does the speaker compare the alabaster box to?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
以下文字选自 Sarojini Naidu 于 1896 年创作的诗歌《雪花石膏》。
如同这只雪花石膏盒，其工艺脆弱如桂皮之花，我的心亦是如此，
雕刻着细腻的梦，铸造着
许多微妙而精致的思绪。
中文解析：
正确答案是 D（她的心）。诗中明确写道“如同这只雪花石膏盒……是我的心”（Like this alabaster box ... is my heart），将“雪花石膏盒”直接比喻为“我的心”。

question:
In the retina of the human eye, long (L), medium (M), and short (S) cone cells help process bright light and color by sending signals to the brain. M cones react to a range in the visible spectrum of light that completely overlaps with those L and S cones react to. As a result,______

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. it is possible to study the roles of L, M, and S cones because each type of cone can be activated without activating the other types.

B. L cones react only to wavelengths associated with the color red, S cones react only to wavelengths associated with the color blue, and M cones react only to wavelengths associated with the color green.
C. it is difficult to exclusively study the role of M cones in human vision under natural conditions because M cones can’t be activated without simultaneously activating the L and S cones.
D. the brain more easily interprets colors in the range both L and M cones react to than those only one type responds to.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在人类视网膜中，长（L）、中（M）、短（S）视锥细胞通过向大脑发送信号来帮助处理亮光和颜色。M 视锥细胞对可见光谱中某一范围的光产生反应，该范围与 L 和 S 视锥细胞产生反应的范围完全重叠。因此，______
中文解析：
前提是 M 锥细胞的光谱反应范围与 L 和 S 锥细胞“完全重叠”，这意味着无法单独激活 M 锥细胞而不同时激活 L 和 S 锥细胞。因此，很难单独研究 M 锥细胞的作用。选项 C 准确推出了这一结论。

question:
As the publisher of the Virginia Gazette, Clementina Rind helped spread ideas that would become important in the American Revolution. In August 1774, she published Thomas Jefferson’s A Summary View of the Rights of British America, a pamphlet______ many of the principles that later appeared in the Declaration of Independence.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 句子主干为“she published... a pamphlet”，空格处需要修饰“pamphlet”的后置定语。现在分词短语“presenting many of the principles...”作定语修饰“pamphlet”，相当于“which presented...”。选项 B 正确。

question:
Diné textile artist D.Y. Begay merges geometric abstraction with realistic landscape imagery in her tapestries Palette of Cochineal (2013) and Winter in the North (2019)._______featured alongside forty-six other tapestries of Begay’s in Sublime Light, a 2025 exhibition at the National Museum of the American Indian.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 前一句明确提到了两件作品（Palette of Cochineal 和 Winter in the North），因此主语应为复数“Both”（两者）。选项 B“Both are”正确。选项 A“All”通常指三个或以上，与“两件”不符；

question:
New Jersey is one of several US states with legislative provisions for the incorporation of worker cooperatives, businesses in which each worker receives an equal vote in company governance. Skeptics have questioned the co-op model for decades and declared ______ means of governance economically unsustainable, ignoring many examples of successful worker-owned businesses.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 空格处需要填入一个形容词性物主代词，修饰“means of governance”（这种治理方式）。前文提到的“the co-op model”是单数形式，因此应用“its”来指代。选项 B 正确。

question:
Portuguese researcher Isabel C.F.R. Ferreira found that termite mushrooms contain gallic acid, an antioxidant that combats free radicals, which are molecules that can damage healthy cells in organisms. Ferreira hopes to harness mushroom antioxidants_____an array of conditions in animals and plants alike.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: “hopes to harness... to...”结构中，不定式“to prevent and treat”作目的状语，且“prevent”和“treat”形式需平行一致。所以选B

question:
To make his textiles, artist Porfirio Gutiérrez uses a natural dyeing method, a process that includes multiple steps. ______the Texas paintbrush or another dye-making material is soaked in water to release its color. Second, the textile is added to the heated dyebath and simmered until the Texas paintbrush’s brown color has transferred into the cloth.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
为了制作他的纺织品，艺术家 Porfirio Gutiérrez 使用了一种天然染色方法，该过程包括多个步骤。______，将 Texas paintbrush 或其他染色材料浸泡在水中以释放其颜色。其次，将纺织品加入加热的染浴中，慢煮直到 Texas paintbrush 的棕色转移到布料上。
中文解析：
文本明确说明该过程包括“多个步骤”，后面出现了“Second”（其次），因此第一个步骤应用“First”（首先）来引导。选项 D 最符合逻辑顺序。选项 C“Next”通常用于非第一步的后续步骤。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
•Ezshwan Winding is a Hungarian American artist who specializes in encaustic painting, which follows a multistep process.
•Step 1: select and prepare the painting surface (often wood).
•Step 2: mix melted wax and resin together and add pigment for color to create the encaustic medium.
•Step 3: spread the medium on the surface in layers, applying heat to allow each layer to soften and fuse with the previous layers.
•Step 4: use various tools to carve patterns into the painting.

The student wants to describe the process of making and applying the encaustic medium. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. The artist creates the medium from wax, resin, and pigment and then spreads it onto a painting surface in layers, heating the layers so that they soften and fuse together.
B. After adding pigment for color, the artist applies a mix of wax and resin to a painting surface, at which point patterns are carved into it.
C. Using various tools, the artist mixes the wax and resin, which fuse together in layers.
D. The artist spreads wax, resin, and pigment onto the encaustic medium (often wood), then applies heat so that they soften and fuse to the previous layers.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在研究某个主题时，一名学生做了以下笔记：
•Ezshwan Winding 是一位匈牙利裔美国艺术家，专攻 encaustic 绘画，该绘画遵循多步骤过程。
•步骤1：选择并准备绘画表面（通常是木材）。
•步骤2：将融化的蜡和树脂混合在一起，并添加颜料以增加颜色，从而制成 encaustic 介质。
•步骤3：将介质分层涂抹在表面上，施加热量使每一层软化并与前一层融合。
•步骤4：使用各种工具在表面雕刻图案
中文解析：
要描述“制作和应用 encaustic 介质”的过程，需涵盖步骤2（制作介质：蜡+树脂+颜料）和步骤3（应用介质：分层涂抹+加热融合）。选项 A 完整包含了这两个步骤。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
•Fireflies produce flashing lights.
•These lights help them attract mates.
•These lights help some fireflies warn off predators.

The student wants to explain how some fireflies use their flashing lights for protection. Which choice best uses information from the notes to do this?
selections: A. Some fireflies produce flashing lights to warn off predators.
B. Some fireflies produce flashing lights to lure prey.
C. Each firefly species has its own unique flashing pattern.
D. Fireflies produce flashing lights to attract mates.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在研究某个主题时，一名学生做了以下笔记：
•萤火虫会产生闪烁的光。
•这些光帮助它们吸引配偶。
•这些光帮助一些萤火虫警告捕食者。
中文解析：
学生想解释“如何进行自我保护”，笔记中明确提到“这些光帮助一些萤火虫警告捕食者”。选项 A 直接复述了这一信息，符合要求。选项 B 的“引诱猎物”与自我保护无关；选项 C 未涉及功能；选项 D 描述的是吸引配偶，而非保护。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
•For centuries in Japan, terraced rice fields (tanada in Japanese) were built by shaping steep hillsides into flat steps.
•This traditional farming method allowed farmers to increase arable land.
•The Kurumeki tanada in Shizuoka Prefecture, Japan, was developed during the Heian period.
•The Heian period (794 CE—1185 CE) was characterized by economic stability and peace.
•The Tenjinkoba tanada in Kumamoto Prefecture, Japan, was developed during the Edo period.
•The Edo period (1603 CE–1868 CE) was characterized by economic stability and peace.

The student wants to emphasize a historical similarity between the two rice terraces. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. The Kurumeki tanada was developed during the Heian period; meanwhile, the Tenjinkoba tanada was developed during the Edo period.
B. The Kurumeki and Tenjinkoba tanada are both exemplars of a traditional farming method wherein flat steps are shaped out of steep hillsides.
C. As was true for the Kurumeki tanada, the Tenjinkoba tanada was developed during a period of economic stability and peace.
D. Developed during the Heian and Edo periods, respectively, the Nakagaachi and Warabino tanada were shaped out of steep hillsides.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在研究某个主题时，一名学生做了以下笔记：
•几个世纪以来，日本通过将陡峭的山坡改造成平坦的阶梯来建造梯田。
•这种传统的耕作方法使农民能够增加可耕地面积。
•日本静冈县的 Kurumeki 梯田建于平安时代。
•平安时代（794年—1185年）以经济稳定与和平为特征。
•日本熊本县的 Tenjinkoba 梯田建于江户时代。
中文解析：
要强调“历史相似性”，需指出两个梯田在历史背景上的共同点。笔记显示平安时代以“经济稳定与和平”为特征，但江户时代的历史特征未给出。选项 C 声称 Tenjinkoba 梯田也在“经济稳定与和平时期”建造，若此信息可从笔记推断或为事实，则构成了相似性。

question:
The perception that a project has no precedent or comparable examples _____ called uniqueness bias. This flawed thinking has the potential to affect project performance significantly, with research showing that uniqueness bias correlates with budget overruns.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 句子的主语是“The perception”（单数），谓语动词应用第三人称单数形式“is”。选项 B 正确。

question:
When the Salon des Refusés art exhibition opened in 1863, visitors openly scoffed at paintings whose experimental styles and original subject matter departed so startlingly from tradition that they had been rejected from the official Paris Salon exhibit.______ these canvases were soon recognized as harbingers of an artistic revolution, with their unconventional elements no longer derided but lauded as the foundation of the late nineteenth-century Impressionist movement.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
selections: A. In keeping with their more traditional counterparts,
B. Despite their initial dismissive reception,
C. Before their Salon des Refusés debut,
D. In response to their Paris Salon rejection,
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
当“落选者沙龙”艺术展于 1863 年开幕时，参观者公然嘲笑那些画作，因为这些画作的实验性风格和原创主题与传统相去甚远，以至于它们曾被官方巴黎沙龙展拒之门外。______ 这些画布很快被确认为艺术革命的先兆，它们那些非传统的元素不再被嘲笑，而是被称赞为 19 世纪末印象派运动的基础。
中文解析：
第一句描述画作被嘲笑（负面反应），第二句说它们很快被认可为革命先兆（正面评价）。两句之间是转折关系，“尽管最初被轻视”最符合逻辑。选项 B“Despite their initial dismissive reception”正确体现了这一转折。

question:
Some famous novels originally had titles very different from those they’re known by today. _____while Ford Madox Ford was writing his classic novel about two couples living in Europe, he called it The Saddest Story—a title he had abandoned in favor of The Good Soldier by the time of the book’s publication in 1915.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
selections: D. In addition to these novels,
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
一些著名小说最初的标题与今天所知的标题大不相同。_____ 当福特·马多克斯·福特在写他那部关于两对生活在欧洲的情侣的经典小说时，他将其命名为《最悲伤的故事》——而到 1915 年该书出版时，他已放弃该标题，转而采用《好士兵》。
中文解析：
第一句提出一个普遍现象（著名小说原标题与现标题不同），第二句以福特的小说为例具体说明。选项 A“To cite one example”（举一个例子）最符合从概括到例证的逻辑过渡。

question:
A 2021 paper by Andrew Payne et al. introduced in situ genome sequencing (IGS), which allows simultaneous sequencing and imaging of genomes within biological samples and facilitates analysis of the relationship between a cell’s DNA and structure. Integrating IGS with expansion microscopy, which uses polymers to enlarge small structures for imaging, a team led by Jason Buenrostro later developed expansion in situ genome sequencing (ExIGS)—a technique that also allows simultaneous sequencing and imaging of genomes, but without the limitations on spatial resolution inherent to IGS.

Which choice best describes the overall structure of the text?
selections: A. It implies that an existing imaging technique for studying DNA samples has become obsolete, proposes that this technique be modified to incorporate elements of a different imaging technique, and then predicts the potential impact of the resulting hybrid technique.

B. It explains the primary function of an older imaging technique, introduces a novel imaging technique that compensates for the original technique’s limitations, and then reveals that the same researchers were responsible for developing both techniques.

C. It introduces an imaging technique that served as the precursor to a newer technique, describes how the older imaging technique was modified to create the newer technique, and then explains a key benefit of the newer technique.

D. It describes the role of an innovative technique that is used in studying DNA samples, notes that this technique can also be used in analysis of cellular structures, and then emphasizes this technique’s superiority to conventional microscope imaging.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
Andrew Payne 等人 2021 年的一篇论文提出了 原位基因组测序（IGS），该技术可以对生物样本中的基因组进行同步测序和成像，有助于分析细胞 DNA 与结构之间的关系。后来，Jason Buenrostro 带领的团队将 IGS 与 扩展显微镜技术（使用聚合物放大微小结构以便成像）相结合，开发出了 扩展原位基因组测序（ExIGS）——该技术同样能够同步测序和成像基因组，但消除了 IGS 固有的空间分辨率限制。
中文解析：
正确答案是 C。文本结构为：先介绍较早期的技术 IGS（作为基础/前身），再说明如何将其与另一种技术（扩展显微镜）结合/修改 形成新技术 ExIGS，最后指出 ExIGS 的关键优势（没有 IGS 的空间分辨率限制）。因此 C 准确概括了“介绍前驱技术 → 描述如何修改创建新技术 → 解释新技术的一个关键优势”这一结构。

question:
The Bantu expansion refers to the gradual dispersal of Bantu-speaking peoples (which today include, among other groups, the Baganda in Uganda and the Chewa in Malawi) and their languages from an ancestral homeland in West-Central Africa across much of sub-Saharan Africa over approximately 3,500 years, starting about 4,000-5,000 years ago (ya). Citing the discovery of pounding equipment dating as far back as 5,000 ya consistent with processing of plant foods, some researchers have asserted that the Bantu expansion can be explained by the farming/ language dispersal hypothesis. This hypothesis proposes that the dispersal of many of the world’s large language families— for instance, Sino-Tibetan—was driven primarily by the adoption of agriculture.

Which finding, if true, would most directly challenge the assertion about the Bantu expansion presented in the text?
selections: A. Among the earliest archaeobotanical evidence of plant farming in East Africa, which Bantu-speaking peoples may have reached as early as 3,500 ya, are traces of cowpea (Vigna unguiculata), a legume crop believed to have originated in West Africa, which were discovered in the Kakapel Rockshelter in present-day Kenya.

B. Reconstructed vocabulary from Proto-Bantu, the ancestral language from which all later Bantu languages descended, contains terms for some wild plant species that early Bantu speakers actively managed and cultivated but that were never fully domesticated into true crop plants.

C. Lexical reconstructions indicate that the earliest Bantu speakers’ words for yams, starchy tubers that are today an agricultural staple throughout sub-Saharan Africa, were inherited from languages predating the arrival of Bantu ancestral groups in their homeland.

D. The earliest unambiguous archaeobotanical evidence of plant cultivation and domestication in West-Central Africa consists of pearl millet (Pennisetum glaucum) found in three sites in present-day Cameroon dated to around 2,200-2,350 ya and in one site in the present-day Democratic Republic of the Congo dated to around 2,200 ya.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
“班图扩张指的是讲班图语的人群（如今包括乌干达的巴干达人和马拉维的切瓦人等）及其语言在大约3500年的时间里，从西非中部的祖先家园逐渐扩散到撒哈拉以南非洲大部分地区的过程，大约始于4000–5000年前。引用与植物性食物加工相一致的、可追溯到5000年前的捣碎工具，一些研究者断言，班图扩张可以用‘农业/语言扩散假说’来解释。该假说提出，世界上许多大型语系（如汉藏语系）的扩散主要由农业的采用所驱动。”
中文解析：
要挑战“农业驱动班图语系扩张”这一断言，最直接的方式是证明农业出现的时间晚于班图扩张开始的时间。选项D指出，西非中部最早的明确农业证据只有约2200-2350年前，而班图扩张始于4000-5000年前，这意味着农业不可能是扩张的驱动力。其他选项要么不涉及时间顺序，要么反而支持农业与扩张的关联。

question:
Polyethylene (PE) plastic sheeting is used as agricultural mulch because it is effective at reducing the propagation of weeds. Seeking a biodegradable alternative, Waqas Ahmad and colleagues tended otherwise equivalent plots of strawberries mulched with PE sheeting or one of several newsprint pulp-based alternatives: just newsprint pulp (NP), pulp bound with guar gum (GG), or pulp bound with psyllium husk (PH). The graph represents strawberry plots for which all emerging weeds were left in place throughout the experiment. Once the fruit was harvested, the weeds were removed, dried, and weighed for dry biomass. Based on the results, there was not a predictable association between treatment effectiveness and fruit yield.

Which choice most effectively uses data from the graph to support the underlined claim?
selections: A. While the psyllium husk treatment was associated with a higher weed biomass than the guar gum treatment was, the guar gum treatment was associated with a higher fruit yield than the psyllium husk treatment was.

B. While the guar gum and polyethylene treatments were associated with the lowest weed biomasses, the guar gum treatment was associated with the highest fruit yield and the polyethylene treatment was associated with the lowest fruit yield.
C. The treatment with just newsprint pulp was associated with the highest weed biomass and was not one of the two treatments associated with the highest fruit yields.
D. The psyllium husk and guar gum treatments were associated with lower weed biomasses and higher fruit yields than the treatment with just newsprint pulp was.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
“聚乙烯（PE）塑料薄膜因其能有效减少杂草繁殖而被用作农业地膜。为了寻求可生物降解的替代品，Waqas Ahmad 及其同事对草莓地块进行了同等处理，分别使用 PE 地膜或几种新闻纸浆基替代品：仅新闻纸浆（NP）、瓜尔胶粘合的纸浆（GG）、或车前草壳粘合的纸浆（PH）。图表显示了实验期间所有长出的杂草都留在地里的草莓地块。果实收获后，将杂草移除、干燥并称重以获取干生物量。根据结果，处理效果与果实产量之间没有可预测的关联。”
中文解析：
正确答案是 B。划线部分的论断是“处理效果与果实产量之间没有可预测的关联”。选项 B 指出：GG 和 PE 处理都具有最低的杂草生物量（即最好的处理效果），但 GG 处理带来了最高的果实产量，而 PE 处理带来了最低的果实产量，这直接证明了“好的处理效果不一定导致高产量”，两者之间没有可预测的关系。其他选项未能如此清晰地展示这种不一致性。

question:
Maltese lithic (stone implement) assemblages from the sixth and seventh millennia BCE exhibit notable characteristics. Nearly all implements were fashioned from limestone—mostly from beach cobbles—rather than superior chert or obsidian, and the assemblages predominantly comprise flakes produced through direct percussion, with negligible representation of cores, blades, or retouched tools. The fairly rudimentary nature of Malta’s lithic industry parallels contemporaneous Sardinian technologies rather than the sophisticated geometric microlith traditions documented in neighboring Sicily.

Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
selections: A. The characteristics of Maltese stone tools from the sixth and seventh millennia BCE are indicative of a level of lithic technological development that, while not uniquely low, was less advanced than that observed nearby in Sicily.

B. While not definitive evidence, the materials and methods used in the production of Maltese stone tools in the sixth andseventh millennia BCE are strongly suggestive of the exchange oflithic technology between Malta, Sardinia, and Sicily.

C. Although Malta, Sardinia, and Sicily all show evidence of lithic industry in the sixth and seventh millennia BCE, the characteristics of the stone tools in each location suggest three distinct levels of technological sophistication.
D. Maltese stone tools from the sixth and seventh millennia BCE are notable for their relative simplicity and their similarity with stone tools produced in Sicily.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
马耳他公元前六至五千纪的石器组合表现出显著特征。几乎所有工具都由石灰岩（主要来自海滩鹅卵石）制成，而非更优质的燧石或黑曜石；这些组合主要包括通过直接敲击产生的石片，而石核、石叶或经过修整的工具几乎可以忽略不计。马耳他石器工业的相当原始的性质与同时期的撒丁岛技术相似，而不是与邻近的西西里岛记录到的复杂的几何形细石叶传统相似。
中文解析：
文本主要描述马耳他石器工具的原始特征（石灰岩、直接敲击），并对比指出其与撒丁岛技术相当，但不如西西里岛的几何形细石叶传统先进。选项 A 准确概括了这一对比关系。

question:
The following text is adapted from Richard Connell’s 1923 short story “The Man Who Could Imitate a Bee.”
An ornithologist is a scientist who studies birds. At twelve [years old Hervey Deyo] had resolved to be a scientist and furthermore a great scientist. He determined to pursue the career of ornithologist; there was something so dignified and withal scientific about a science that called the sparrow Passer domesticus and the robin Erithacus rubecula. He made rapid progress. On his thirteenth birthday he took a bird walk at dawn and was able to record in his note-book the scientific names of forty-nine birds, including the ruby-and-topaz humming-bird (Chrysolampis mosquitus) which is rare in that part of the country.

According to the text, what motivates Hervey Deyo to become an ornithologist rather than another kind of scientist?
selections: A. The opportunity to take peaceful morning walks in nature
B. The scientific names used for birds
C. His early success in identifying rare birds
D. His general ambition to become a great scientist in any field
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
以下文字改编自 Richard Connell 1923 年的短篇小说《能模仿蜜蜂的人》。鸟类学家是研究鸟类的科学家。Hervey Deyo 在十二岁时就决心成为一名科学家，而且是一位伟大的科学家。他决定追求鸟类学家的职业；一门把麻雀称为 Passer domesticus、把知更鸟称为 Erithacus rubecula 的科学，有一种如此庄重且颇具科学感的东西。他进步迅速。十三岁生日那天，他在黎明时分进行了一次观鸟徒步，并在笔记本中记录了 49 种鸟类的学名，其中包括稀有的红玉蜂鸟（Chrysolampis mosquitus）。
中文解析：
文本明确指出，他决定成为鸟类学家是因为“有一种如此庄重且颇具科学感的东西”存在于“一门把麻雀称为 Passer domesticus、把知更鸟称为 Erithacus rubecula 的科学”中，即学名吸引了他。选项B 正确。

question:
Text 1
In 2015 Dénia, Spain, was named a City of Gastronomy by UNESCO in recognition of the city’s unique food culture. The honor is well known among both residents of the city and tourists who visit. It’s obvious that the selection of Dénia by UNESCO has brought awareness to local recipes, cooking practices, and chefs and has provided a boost to the city’s tourism industry.
Text 2
Many people in Dénia’s restaurant industry hoped that food tourism would increase after the city was chosen as a City of Gastronomy in 2015. However, as researcher Eerang Park and colleagues argue, cities must still create effective marketing strategies to benefit fully from being named a City of Gastronomy. Without an intentional effort to promote the city’s food scene, many current and potential visitors to Dénia may not even be aware that it’s home to uniquely delicious food.

Based on the texts, how would the author of Text 2 most likely respond to the underlined claim in Text 1?
selections: A. By suggesting that a significant number of visitors to Dénia may not know that the city has been officially named a City of Gastronomy
B. By arguing that UNESCO’s recognition of Dénia was well deserved because of the city's delicious food
C. By noting that there are other benefits to being named a City of Gastronomy besides increased tourism
D. By claiming that Dénia’s chefs were mainly responsible for the city’s recognition by UNESCO
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
文本 1（画线部分见原文，此处转述）：
2015 年，西班牙德尼亚被联合国教科文组织（UNESCO）评为“美食之都”，以表彰该市独特的饮食文化。这一荣誉在当地居民和游客中广为人知。显然，UNESCO 对德尼亚的评选提升了当地食谱、烹饪方式和厨师的知名度，并为该市旅游业带来了推动。
文本 2：
德尼亚餐饮业的许多人原本希望 2015 年被评为“美食之都”后，美食旅游会有所增长。然而，正如研究员 Eerang Park 及其同事所言，城市仍需制定有效的营销策略，才能从“美食之都”称号中充分受益。如果不有意推广城市的美食场景，许多现有及潜在的德尼亚游客可能甚至不知道这里拥有独特美味的食物。
中文解析：
正确答案是 A。文本 2 指出，如果没有主动推广，许多游客可能并不知道德尼亚拥有独特的美食，这直接回应了文本 1 中“荣誉在当地居民和游客中广为人知”的说法。文本 2 的作者会用“游客可能并不知道”来质疑文本 1 中关于知名度高的主张。

question:
A trend away from stable, relatively high humidity in the Middle East over the past 8 million years can be inferred from the composition of cave formations dating to different periods. Cave formations from about 7 million years ago mainly consist of transparent columnar calcite, indicative of an underground water system regularly replenished by rainfall. Cave formations younger than approximately 1 million years, however, mainly consist of branching, opaque (and sometimes colorful) material, often with more frequent growth interruptions, indicating an intermittent water supply.

Which choice best describes the function of the two underlined portions in the text as a whole?
selections: A. They describe divergent features of cave formations that when taken together imply decreasing variation in Middle Eastern rainfall over time.
B. They identify different characteristics of cave formations that when considered together provide evidence for a long-term shift toward lower and more variable humidity in the Middle East.
C. They provide evidence from different Middle Eastern cave formations that substantiates the claim that the region experienced a long period of relatively high humidity.
D. They draw a contrast between Middle Eastern cave formations that is suggestive of geographic differences in the underground water supply.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
“过去 800 万年来中东地区稳定、相对较高的湿度逐渐减弱的趋势，可以从不同时期洞穴构造的成分中推断出来。大约 700 万年前的洞穴构造主要由透明的柱状方解石组成，这表明存在一个由降雨定期补给的地下水资源系统。然而，大约不到 100 万年前的洞穴构造主要由分支状、不透明（有时带有彩色）的材料组成，通常伴有更频繁的生长中断，这表明水源供应是间歇性的。”
中文解析：
正确答案是 B。两处划线部分分别描述了两类洞穴构造的特征：古老构造（约 700 万年前）表明稳定、规律的水源，年轻构造（不到 100 万年前）表明间歇性、不稳定的水源。两者合在一起，为中东地区湿度长期向低和更不稳定的趋势变化提供了证据。其他选项：A 说“降雨变化减小”，与趋势相反；C 只强调“长期高湿度”，忽略了转向低湿度的变化；D 将差异归因于“地理差异”，而文中强调的是时间差异。

question:
Text 1
Cymbals Eat Guitars’ 2009 song “And The Hazy Sea” includes a specific musical pattern. That pattern consists of two alternating notes sung over and over with “wa” and “oh” sounds, resulting in a sequence of “Wa-oh-wa-oh.” This pattern showed up in so many pop songs in the 2000s and 2010s that eventually it earned a nickname, “the millennial whoop.” The whoop showed up so frequently that some musicians and critics felt it had grown irritating.
Text 2
The millennial whoop could be annoying. Not every pop song needs “Wa-oh-wa-ohs!” and it seemed as though nearly every pop song released between 2000 and 2017 had them. But the whoop could also be genuinely fun or even moving. Too many songwriters used it in too many pop songs for a time, but that doesn’t mean the whoop was never used well.

Based on the texts, what would the author of Text 2 most likely say in response to the underlined portion of Text 1?
selections: A. “The millennial whoop is worth talking about, but other musical patterns are more interesting.”
B. “There are better examples of the millennial whoop than the one found in ‘And The Hazy Sea.’”
C. “It’s true that the millennial whoop could be annoying, but it could also be wonderful.”
D. “The millennial whoop wasn’t used as often as some people think.”
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
文本 1
Cymbals Eat Guitars 乐队 2009 年的歌曲《And The Hazy Sea》包含一种特定的音乐模式。这种模式由两个交替的音符组成，配以“wa”和“oh”的声音反复演唱，形成“Wa-oh-wa-oh”的序列。这种模式在 2000 年代和 2010 年代出现在大量流行歌曲中，最终获得了一个绰号——“千禧年呼号”。这种呼号出现得如此频繁，以至于一些音乐人和评论家觉得它已变得令人厌烦。
文本 2
千禧年呼号可能令人厌烦。并非每首流行歌曲都需要“Wa-oh-wa-ohs！”，而似乎 2000 年至 2017 年间发行的几乎所有流行歌曲都有它。但这种呼号也可能真正有趣，甚至动人。曾有一段时间，太多词曲作者在太多流行歌曲中使用了它，但这并不意味着千禧年呼号从未被用得巧妙。
中文解析：
正确答案是 C。文本 2 第一句承认千禧年呼号“可能令人厌烦”，呼应文本 1 中“令人厌烦”的观点；接着又指出它“可能真正有趣，甚至动人”，与文本 1 的负面评价形成补充与平衡，因此选项 C 准确概括了文本 2 的核心态度。

question:
Truly sustainable agricultural systems must balance ecological, financial, and human considerations. Despite many consumers’ exclusive focus on environmental impacts, sustainable agriculture also ______ the economic viability of farm operations and the social well-being of agricultural communities.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
真正可持续的农业系统必须平衡生态、经济和人文方面的考量。尽管许多消费者只关注环境影响，但可持续农业也 ______ 农场经营的经济可行性和农业社区的社会福祉。
答案解析：
句子说可持续农业要平衡三方面，但消费者只关注环境，因此需要指出可持续农业也 包含（encompasses） 经济和社会层面。B（分类）、C（取代）、D（孤立）在逻辑和语义上均不符合。

question:
Ray Bradbury’s 1957 novel Dandelion Wine is regularly described as autobiography. That characterization is apt—there are many parallels between the experiences of the novel’s protagonist, Douglas Spaulding, and those of Bradbury—but it should not be taken to mean that every person or event depicted in Dandelion Wine has a real-life analogue. Much of the novel is pure invention, and readers who neglect this fact and instead focus excessively on correspondences between the novel and Bradbury’s life can thus_____

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. overemphasize the extent to which Bradbury took inspiration from earlier writers.
B. refuse to acknowledge that Bradbury drew on real-world material when writing Dandelion Wine.
C. misrepresent Dandelion Wine as being more widely read than it actually is.
D. fail to appreciate how much creativity Bradbury shows in the book.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
雷·布拉德伯里 1957 年的小说《蒲公英酒》经常被描述为自传。这种描述是恰当的——小说主人公道格拉斯·斯波尔丁的经历与布拉德伯里的经历有许多相似之处——但这不应被理解为《蒲公英酒》中描绘的每一个人物或事件都有现实生活中的对应。小说的大部分内容是纯粹的虚构，而忽视这一事实、过分关注小说与布拉德伯里生活之间对应关系的读者，可能会因此 ______。
中文解析：
文本指出小说大部分是“纯粹的虚构”，而过分关注现实对应关系的读者会忽略这一事实。因此，他们无法欣赏作者“创造”的部分，即选项 D 所说的“创造力”。

question:
In areas with mineral-rich water, mineral deposits may build up inside water heaters. If not treated or removed, these deposits can grow large enough to_______ heat transfer, thereby undermining the main function of the devices.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在富含矿物质水的地区，水加热器内部可能会积聚矿物质沉积物。如果不加以处理或清除，这些沉积物可能会长得足够大，从而_______热量传递，进而削弱设备的主要功能。
中文解析：
沉积物积聚在加热器内部会形成障碍，阻碍热量从热源传递到水中，从而削弱加热功能。选项 D“impede”（阻碍）最准确地表达了这一负面作用。选项 A“isolate”过于绝对（完全隔离），不如“impede”恰当。

question:
The geographic distribution of animal characters in traditional stories typically _____ current distributions of corresponding species, likely because such stories often serve to transmit information cautioning about local wildlife. Folktales from the British Isles featuring bears are an apparent exception, persisting as culturally significant long after wild bears had gone extinct there.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
传统故事中动物角色的地理分布通常 _____ 相应物种的当前分布，这可能是因为这类故事常常用于传递提醒人们注意当地野生动物的信息。以不列颠群岛为背景、出现熊的民间故事则是一个明显的例外，这些故事在野生熊在当地灭绝很久之后仍然具有文化重要性。
答案解析：
第一句说故事中动物的分布通常与物种当前的实际分布一致，因为故事有提醒当地人注意野生动物的功能。第二句以“熊”为例说明例外（熊已灭绝但故事仍有）。因此填入“与……一致”，aligns with 最准确。B（默许）、C（偏离）、D（补偿）均不符合逻辑。

question:
Patent data suggest that technology start-ups (newly established businesses) are more likely to develop innovative products than established technology companies are. The established tech companies have fewer ______ to create groundbreaking products because the sale of new products could compete with the sale of their existing products.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
专利数据表明，技术初创企业比成熟技术公司更有可能开发创新产品。成熟科技公司缺乏开发突破性产品的 ______ ，因为新产品的销售可能会与它们现有产品的销售形成竞争。
中文解析：
因为成熟公司的新产品会蚕食现有产品的市场，所以它们缺乏动机/动力（incentives）去开发突破性产品，而不是缺少障碍、选项或妥协。A（障碍）逻辑反了——实际上它们面临障碍，但句子说的是“更少的障碍”并不符合因果解释；incentives 最精确地表达了“不愿意去做”的经济动因。

question:
The National Heritage Fellowship was created to raise public awareness about exceptional folk and traditional artists in the United States. In 2022, the fellowship was given to the builder of Native Hawaiian hale (thatched houses) Francis Palani Sinenci to ______ his lifetime contributions to the arts.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
美国国家传统奖学金的设立是为了提高公众对美国杰出民间及传统艺术家的认识。2022年，该奖学金被授予夏威夷原住民草屋建造者弗朗西斯·帕拉尼·西嫩西，以______他毕生对艺术的贡献。
中文解析：
该奖学金的目的本来就是“提高公众认识”，因此授予西嫩西是为了 宣传/推广（promote） 他毕生的艺术贡献。其他选项：divide（分割）、compel（强迫）、cluster（聚集）在语义和逻辑上均不符合语境。

question:
Just like household dust on Earth, dust on the International Space Station (ISS) harbors hundreds of common microorganisms—Aspergillus sydowii and other fungi, along with bacteria, such as Corynebacterium kroppenstedtii. According to experiments conducted using samples of ISS dust of initially similar compositions, changes in both relative humidity (RH) and duration of humidity exposure elicit changes in growth for both fungal and bacterial species. However, when overall fungal growth increased, it was mainly due to an increase in growth of A. sydowii, whereas bacterial growth was widely distributed across species in the samples.

Taken together, information in the text and table best support which statement about the ISS dust samples following the conclusion of the experiment?
selections: A. The sample at 85% RH for 12 hours/day contained a lower proportion of A. sydowii than the sample at 100% RH for 24 hours/ day did.
B. The sample at 100% RH for 24 hours/ day contained the highest proportion of fungi among the three samples.
C. The sample at 85% RH for 12 hours/ day contained a lower proportion of C. kroppenstedtii than the sample at 100% RH for 24 hours/ day did.
D. The sample at 100% RH for 24 hours/ day contained a higher proportion of fungi than bacteria.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
“就像地球上的家庭灰尘一样，国际空间站上的灰尘也含有数百种常见微生物——Aspergillus sydowii 等真菌，以及 Corynebacterium kroppenstedtii 等细菌。根据使用初始成分相似的国际空间站粉尘样本进行的实验，相对湿度和湿度暴露时长的变化都引起了真菌和细菌物种生长的变化。然而，当整体真菌生长增加时，这主要是由于 A. sydowii 的生长增加所致，而细菌的生长则广泛分布于样本中的各个物种。”
中文解析：
正确答案是 A。文本指出整体真菌生长增加时，主要是由于 A. sydowii 的生长增加所致。由表格可知，100% RH/24小时条件下的真菌生长速率最高，说明 A. sydowii 的比例也相应较高；而85% RH/12小时条件下的真菌生长速率最低，因此 A. sydowii 比例应较低。选项 A 正是这一推断的合理表达。

question:
In English metrical poetry, disyllabic words that consist of one unstressed syllable followed by one stressed syllable, like “eclipsed,” are called iambs, whereas disyllabic words in which the unstressed syllable follows the stressed one (such as_____are classified as trochees.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 不管是从句还是主语，主语和谓语之间都不可以用加入分号，破折号和逗号，所以选B

question:
Featured among the more than 120 photographs in the 2021 exhibition The New Woman Behind the Camera, Olga Máthé's______ “Fisherman's Dock” offers a glimpse back in time to 1930.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 限定性同位语，所以无需添加逗号或冒号。

question:
In British gothic fiction of the eighteenth century, gone are the rational narratives that dominated earlier literary movements of the Enlightenment period. In ______ place are stories rife with the supernatural and psychological intensity that appealed to readers seeking escape from the Age of Reason.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 句子结构为“In ______ place”，指代前文提到的“rational narratives”, 所以选A

question:
Researchers have long been aware that pistol shrimp use a specialized claw to create bubbles that stun their prey, but understanding of the phenomenon has been limited by researchers’ inability to accurately measure the tiny, rapid movements of the shrimp. ______ scientists have turned to computer simulations to re-create the claw’s closing motion, allowing them to track the pressure, speed, and density of water throughout the bubble formation.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
selections: A. In light of this limitation,
B. Adding the flaws in their hypothesis,
D. To determine where they went wrong,
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
研究人员早就知道枪虾使用特殊的螯制造气泡来击晕猎物，但由于研究人员无法准确测量虾的微小快速运动，对这一现象的理解一直受到限制。______ 科学家们转向计算机模拟来重现螯的闭合动作，从而能够追踪气泡形成整个过程中的水压、速度及密度。
中文解析：
前一句提到“无法准确测量”是一个限制因素，后一句说科学家转向计算机模拟来克服这一限制。选项 A“In light of this limitation”（鉴于这一限制）最符合逻辑，表明后续行动是针对前文所述问题而采取的。其他选项均未准确体现这种因果关系。

question:
When Indhu Rubasingham was announced as the National Theatre’s new artistic director in late 2023, theater leadership across the UK_______ increasingly corporate in structure, with a growing number of venues experimenting with models that would place executives in leadership, eliminating the artistic director position entirely.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 主句描述的是在“当……时”（when 引导的时间状语从句，过去时）这个时间点正在发生的变化，应用过去进行时“was becoming”，表示“正在变得日益公司化”。选项 B 一般过去时暗示已完成的动作，C 现在完成时与过去时间点不匹配，D 过去将来时不符合此处语境。

question:
Writing in hieroglyphs, ancient Egyptians recorded measurements using units such as the khefa, a unit of_____and the sa, a unit of area. The khefa, for instance, is written as a short, horizontal hieroglyph shaped like the back of a fist.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
selections: A. length; the khar; a unit of volume;
B. length, the khar; a unit of volume,
C. length; the khar, a unit of volume;
D. length the khar, a unit of volume
explanations: 平行结构，higher level并列用分号，lower level并列用逗号

question:
Elisabetta Sirani employed several artistic techniques in her 1663 work Virgin and Child._______ the work is notable for the artist’s use of Chiaroscuro, which involves integrating strong contrasts of light and shadow.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
Elisabetta Sirani 在她 1663 年的作品《圣母与圣子》中运用了多种艺术技法。_______ 该作品以艺术家使用明暗对照法而著称，这种技法涉及强烈的光影对比。
中文解析：
第一句提到艺术家使用了“多种艺术技法”，第二句具体指出其中“明暗对照法”是作品的显著特点。选项 A“In particular”（尤其是）起到了从一般到具体的递进作用。

question:
A recent study found that groups of Paratrechina longicornis ants solved a geometric puzzle more efficiently than human groups. While humans performed well as individuals because of strategic thinking, working in teams did not enhance humans’problem-solving efficiency._____ as part of a closely connected colony, the ants effectively used shared memory and coordination, collectively solving a problem that no ant could have solved alone.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
最近一项研究发现，长角立毛蚁群体在解决几何谜题时比人类群体更高效。虽然人类凭借策略性思维作为个体表现良好，但团队合作并未提高人类解决问题的效率。_____ 作为紧密连接的蚁群的一部分，蚂蚁有效地利用了共享记忆和协作，共同解决了一个没有蚂蚁能独自解决的问题。
中文解析：
前一句说人类团队合作没有提高效率，后一句说蚂蚁合作有效解决了问题。两者形成对比关系，因此用“Conversely”（相反地）最符合逻辑。其他选项分别表示因果、补充或类比，不符合此处转折对比的逻辑。

question:
Among its thousands of portraits of well-known figures from British history, London's National Portrait Gallery (NPG) includes self-portraits by noteworthy British artists, including one of Rachel Strachey._______the subjects of most NPG portraits are different from (and more famous than) the artists who painted them.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
selections: A. However, Strachey’s portrait is not the only self-portrait of an artist in the museum:
B. Of course, such portraits are anomalies in the context of the museum’s collection:
C. Furthermore, Strachey’s portrait exemplifies the museum's bias in favor of autoportraiture:
D. Consequently, such portraits reinforce the museum’s curatorial philosophy:
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在伦敦国家肖像馆（NPG）收藏的数千幅英国历史名人肖像中，也包括英国著名艺术家的自画像，其中就有雷切尔·斯特雷奇的一幅。_______ 国家肖像馆大多数肖像画的主体（比画他们的艺术家）更出名，也与艺术家本人不同。
中文解析：
第一句提到博物馆收藏了艺术家的自画像（包括 Strachey 的），第二句指出大多数肖像画的主题是比艺术家更出名的历史人物。这意味着艺术家自画像在博物馆中属于少数、不典型的情况。选项 B 说这类肖像画是“异常情况”，逻辑连贯地连接了两句。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
·The typical resting viscosity of oobleck (cornstarch mixed with water) is 5-100 centipoise (cP).
·Oobleck increases in viscosity (becomes thicker) when stirred.
·The typical resting viscosity of fruit jam is 5,000-10,000 (cP).
·Fruit jam decreases in viscosity (becomes thinner) when stirred.
·A fluid is Newtonian if its viscosity remains stable under shear (mechanical force such as being stirred or squeezed).
·A fluid is non-Newtonian if its viscosity changes under shear.

The student wants to contrast how shear affects fruit jam and oobleck. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Though the viscosities of both oobleck and fruit jam change under shear, oobleck’s typical resting viscosity (5-100 cP) is lower than that of fruit jam (5,000-10,000 cP).
B. Fruit jam is non-Newtonian, meaning its viscosity decreases under shear; oobleck, by contrast, increases in viscosity.
C. Fruit jam becomes thinner when stirred, while oobleck becomes thicker.
D. Oobleck has a much lower resting viscosity than fruit jam but becomes thicker under shear.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在研究一个主题时，一名学生记录了以下笔记：
•欧不裂（玉米淀粉与水混合）的典型静态粘度为 5–100 厘泊（cP）。
•欧不裂在搅拌时粘度增加（变稠）。
•果酱的典型静态粘度为 5,000–10,000 cP。
•果酱在搅拌时粘度降低（变稀）。
•如果一种流体在剪切力（如搅拌或挤压等机械力）下粘度保持稳定，则它是牛顿流体。
•如果一种流体在剪切力下粘度发生变化，则它是非牛顿流体。
中文解析：
正确答案是 C。该选项直接对比了果酱和欧不裂在剪切力（搅拌）下的相反行为：果酱变稀，而欧不裂变稠，这是最清晰、最直接的对比方式。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
·Fused deposition modeling (FDM) is one type of 3D printing technology.
·FDM is also called material extrusion.
·FDM printers eject a modeling medium through a heated nozzle to build an object layer by layer.
·Italian company Barilla uses FDM printers that extrude layers of semolina and water dough to create unique shapes of pasta.
·Ukrainian entrepreneur Dinara Kasko uses an FDM printer that extrudes layers of silicone to create uniquely shaped molds for baking cakes.

The student wants to emphasize a difference between Barilla’s and Kasko’s uses of FDM printing technology. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Barilla uses FDM printing to build layers of pasta dough into unique shapes, whereas Kasko uses FDM printing to build layers of uniquely shaped cakes.
B. While both Barilla and Kasko use FDM printers to create uniquely shaped 3D objects, Barilla is using the technology to produce food and Kasko isn’t.
C. Barilla and Kasko have developed different uses for FDM printing, a 3D printing technology also known as material extrusion.
D. FDM printing technology has many uses, from creating uniquely shaped pasta from semolina and water dough to constructing cake molds from silicone.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在研究一个主题时，一名学生记录了以下笔记：
•熔融沉积建模（FDM）是一种 3D 打印技术。
•FDM 也称为材料挤出。
•FDM 打印机通过加热喷嘴喷射建模介质，逐层构建物体。
•意大利公司 Barilla 使用 FDM 打印机挤出粗面粉和水面团层，以制作独特形状的意大利面。
•乌克兰企业家 Dinara Kasko 使用 FDM 打印机挤出硅胶层，以制作独特形状的蛋糕烘焙模具。
中文解析：
正确答案是 B。该选项既指出二者都在用 FDM 打印独特形状的 3D 物体，又明确点出关键区别：Barilla 用于生产食物（意大利面），而 Kasko 不是（生产硅胶模具，不能食用）。其他选项：A 说 Kasko “用 FDM 构建独特形状的蛋糕层”，但笔记明确说她制作的是蛋糕模具，不是蛋糕本身；C 只笼统说“不同的用途”，未具体说明区别是什么；D 根本没有提到两家公司或对比关系。

question: In the xy-plane, circle M is the graph of the equation <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>2</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>y</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>6</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>=</mo><mn>9</mn></math>. Circle P has the same center as circle M but has a radius that is twice the radius of circle M. Which equation represents circle P ?

If the equations <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>−</mo><mn>9</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>20</mn></math> and <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>9</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>20</mn></math> are graphed in the xy-plane, at what point (x,y) do the graphs intersect?

question: The product of a positive number x and the number that is 9 more than x is 52 . What is the value of x ?
explanations: x(x+9)=52。化简得<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>9</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>52</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math>，分解因式得(x+13)(x-4)=0。因此x=-13或4。因为x是正数，所以x=4，选B。

question: A model estimates that the initial number of photons in an X-ray beam is 600 when the beam reaches the surface of a certain material. selections: A. The number of tomato seeds planted is predicted to increase by 70 seeds every 100 days.
B. The number of tomato seeds planted is predicted to increase by 350 seeds every 100 days.

question: Triangle ABC is similar to triangle XYZ such that A,B, and C correspond to X,Y, and Z, respectively. The length of each side of triangle ABC is n times the length of its corresponding side in triangle XYZ, where n is an integer greater than 1 . The measure of angle C is 58 degrees, and YZ=71. Which of the following must be true?
selections: A. The measure of angle Z is <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><mn>58</mn><mi>n</mi></mfrac></math> degrees.
B. The measure of angle Z is 58n degrees.
explanations: 相似的三角形对应的角相等，所以角Z为58度。BC边的长度是n乘以YZ边的长度，为71n。选D

question: If <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><mi>x</mi><mn>5</mn></mfrac><mo>+</mo><mn>18</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>18</mn><mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"><mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo><mfrac><mi>x</mi><mn>5</mn></mfrac><mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo></mrow></math>, what is the value of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><mi>x</mi><mn>5</mn></mfrac></math> ?
explanations: 等式两边同时减去x/5得到18=17(x/5)。等式两边同时除以17得到x/5=18/17约等于1.059。

question: In triangles RST and XYZ shown, <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover><mrow><mi>X</mi><mi>Y</mi></mrow><mo accent="true">―</mo></mover></math> is parallel to <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover><mrow><mi>T</mi><mi>S</mi></mrow><mo accent="true">―</mo></mover></math> and tan <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>R</mi><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mn>120</mn><mn>209</mn></mfrac></math>. What is the value of sin⁡X in triangle XYZ ?
explanations: 因为XY平行于TS，所以∠X=∠S。因此sin X=sin S=RT/RS。因为tan R=120/209=TS/TR，假设TS=120和TR=209，由勾股定理，解出RS=241。因此sin X=RT/RS=209/241。选C

question: Line j is defined by <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>4</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>5</mn><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>25</mn></math>. An equation of line k is <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>16</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>r</mi><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>15</mn></math>, where r is a constant. If line k passes through the point (0, b), what is the value of b ?
explanations: 化简直线j的等式得到：<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mo>−</mo><mn>4</mn></mrow><mn>5</mn></mfrac><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>5</mn></math>。直线j的斜率为-4/5。因为直线j平行于直线k，所以直线k的斜率为-4/5。直线k的等式可以写为<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mo>−</mo><mfrac><mn>4</mn><mn>5</mn></mfrac><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>b</mi></math>。等式两边同时乘以5得到5y=-4x+5b，即4x+5y=5b。等式两边同时乘以4得到：16x+20y=20b。因此20b=15，解出b=0.75。

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mtable columnalign="right left" columnspacing="0em" displaystyle="true" rowspacing="3pt"><mtr><mtd></mtd><mtd><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>4</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>47</mn></mtd></mtr><mtr><mtd></mtd><mtd><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>p</mi><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>43</mn></mtd></mtr></mtable></math>
In the given system of equations, p is a positive constant. The graphs of the equations in the given system intersect at exactly one point, (x, y), in the xy-plane. What is the value of x ?
explanations: <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>4</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>47</mn><mo>=</mo><mi>p</mi><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>43</mn></math>只有一个解，化简得<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>4</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mi>p</mi><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math>只有一个解，因此<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">Δ</mi><mo>=</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mo>−</mo><mi>p</mi><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>4</mn><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>4</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>4</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math>，解出p=8或-8.因为p是正数，所以p=8。将p=8带入等式得到<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>4</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>8</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math>，即<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math>。配方得<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math>,解出x=1。选A

question: Each 3.0 -ounce serving of cheddar cheese and each 1.2 -ounce serving of tuna provides about 1 microgram of vitamin B12. If a total of 1.8 micrograms of vitamin B12 are consumed from eating x ounces of cheese and y ounces of tuna, which equation best represents this situation?
explanations: 因为每3盎司芝士提供1毫克维他命B12，所以x盎司芝士提供x/3毫克维他命。因为1.2盎司金枪鱼提供1毫克维他命，所以y盎司金枪鱼提供y/1.2毫克维他命。因此x/3+y/1.2=1.8，约等于0.33x+0.83y=1.8。选D

question: If <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi><mo>≥</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>8</mn></math> represents all solutions to the inequality <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>a</mi><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>12</mn><mo>≤</mo><mn>36</mn></math>, where a is a constant, what is the greatest possible value of a ?
explanations: 因为ax−12≤36，两边同时加上12得ax≤48。因为不等式方向改变，所以a<0，等式两边同时除以a得到x≥48>

question: The graph shows the estimated boiling point y, in degrees Celsius, of a straight-chain alkane with a molecular weight of x grams per mole, where 1≤x≤280. Which statement is the best interpretation of the point (155.21,  196.74) ?
selections: A. A straight-chain alkane with a molecular weight of 196.74 grams per mole has an estimated boiling point of 155.21 degrees Celsius.
B. A straight-chain alkane with a molecular weight of 155.21 grams per mole has an estimated boiling point of 196.74 degrees Celsius.
C. The minimum estimated boiling point for straight-chain alkanes corresponds to an alkane with a molecular weight of 155.21 grams per mole and an estimated boiling point of 196.74 degrees Celsius.
D. The maximum estimated boiling point for straight-chain alkanes corresponds to an alkane with a molecular weight of 155.21 grams per mole and an estimated boiling point of 196.74 degrees Celsius.
explanations: x=155.21且x表示一种直链烷烃的分子质量，y=196.74且y表示沸点。因此分子质量为155.21克每摩尔的直链烷烃的沸点为196.74。选B。

question: The function f is defined by <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>41</mn><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>0.26</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mi>x</mi></msup></math>. For any positive integer n, the value of f(n) is <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>p</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">%</mi></math> less than the value of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>n</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>. What is the value of p ?
explanations: <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><mrow><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>n</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>−</mo><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>n</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mrow><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>n</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mn>41</mn><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>0.26</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mi>n</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>41</mn><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>0.26</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mi>n</mi></msup></mrow><mrow><mn>41</mn><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>0.26</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mi>n</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></mrow></mfrac></math>。分子分母同时除以<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>41</mn><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>0.26</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mi>n</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></math>得到1-0.26=0.74=74%.选A

question: A right square prism has a height of 9 units. The volume of the prism is 324 cubic units. What is the length, in units, of an edge of the base?
explanations: 棱柱的体积为底面积乘高，所以9*底面积=324，解出底面积为36。因为底面为正方形，所以底边长为6，选A

question: The line shown can be represented by the equation <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>a</mi><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>b</mi><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>48</mn></math>, where a and b are constants. Which of the following is true about a and b ?
explanations: 函数图像经过点（4， 0），带入方程得到4a=48，解得a=12>0。函数图像经过点（0， -3），带入方程得到-3b=48，解得b=-16<0。选c

question: Each angle of △ABC is congruent to one of the angles of △QRS. If AB=44, BC=66,AC=88, and RS=264, what is one possible value for the perimeter of △QRS ?
explanations: 因为三角形 ABC 与三角形 QRS 的对应角相等，所以两个三角形相似，对应边成比例。已知 AB = 44，BC = 66，AC = 88，RS = 264。题目没有明确 RS 对应哪一条边，但要求我们求出一个可能的周长，因此可以假设一种对应关系。假设 RS 对应 AC（长度为 88），则相似比为：k = RS / AC = 264 / 88 = 3。那么：QR = AB × 3 = 44 × 3 = 132；QS = BC × 3 = 66 × 3 = 198。因此三角形 QRS 的周长为：QR + RS + QS = 132 + 264 + 198 = 594（注：如果 RS 对应 AB 或 BC，还可得到另外两个可能的周长 1188 和 792。题目只要求一个可能值，所以 594 是正确答案之一。）

question: Line t in the xy-plane has a slope of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mn>8</mn></mfrac></math> and passes through the point (40,−9). Which equation defines line t ?
explanations: <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>y</mi><mo>−</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>9</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mn>8</mn></mfrac><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>40</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>。化简得<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mn>8</mn></mfrac><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>14</mn></math>。选B

question:

The function g is defined by <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>g</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>8</mn></math>, where <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>g</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>a</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>18 </mn></math>and <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>g</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>4</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mi>b</mi></math>. What is the value of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>a</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>b</mi></math>?
explanations: 因为g(a)=18，所以2a+8=18，解出a=5。因为g(4)=b，所以2(4)+8=b，解出b=16。因此a+b=21，选C。

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>−</mo><mn>3</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>15</mn><mi>p</mi><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>60</mn></math>
In the given equation, p is a constant. The equation has no solution. What is the value of p ?

A community organization surveyed a random sample of residents of the community to estimate the percentage of residents who visit their local library at least once per month. From the survey, the organization estimates that <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mtext>12%</mtext></math> of residents of the community visit their local library at least once per month, with an associated margin of error of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>3.7</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">%</mi></math>. The organization repeated the survey with a random sample of residents that was double the original sample size. Assuming the margins of error are calculated in the same way for both studies, which of the following is true about the margin of error associated with the estimate from the larger sample?
selections: A. The margin of error is less than 3.7%.
B. The margin of error is 7.4%.
C. The margin of error is greater than 12%.
D. The margin of error is 24%.
explanations: 样本越大，误差越小。选A

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mtable columnalign="right left" columnspacing="0em" displaystyle="true" rowspacing="3pt"><mtr><mtd></mtd><mtd><mi>y</mi><mo><</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>6</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>18</mn></mtd></mtr><mtr><mtd></mtd><mtd><mi>y</mi><mo>></mo><mo>−</mo><mn>4</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>11</mn></mtd></mtr></mtable></math>
For which of the following tables are all the values of x and their corresponding values of y solutions to the given system of inequalities?

question: The expression <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><mrow><mi>k</mi><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>42</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>11</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>15</mn></mrow></mfrac></math> is equivalent to <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><mi>p</mi><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow></mfrac><mo>−</mo><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mrow><mn>2</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>5</mn></mrow></mfrac></math>, where k and p are constants. What is the value of p ?
explanations: <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><mi>p</mi><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow></mfrac><mo>−</mo><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mrow><mn>2</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>5</mn></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi>p</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>5</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>−</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>3</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>3</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>5</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>p</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>5</mn><mi>p</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>11</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>15</mn></mrow></mfrac></math>。因此-5p+3=-42，解出p=9，选C

question:

In the xy-plane, the graph of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math> has a vertex at (1,9) and passes through the points (2,37) and (−1,121). What is the value of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>2</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>−</mo><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>0</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>?
explanations: 因为顶点为(1, 9)。设方程为<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mi>a</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>9</mn></math>。带入点(2, 37)得到37=a+9，解出a=28。因此<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>28</mn><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>9</mn></math>。计算得f(-2)=261和f(0)=37。因此f(-2)-f(0)=224.

question:
The area of a rectangular region is increasing at a rate of 140 square feet per hour. Which of the following is closest to this rate in isquare meters per minute?
(Use 1 meter =3.28 feet.)
explanations: 因为1米=3.28英尺，所以1平方米=10.7584平方英尺。因此140平方英尺每小时=13.013平方米每小时=0.217平方米每分钟，约等于0.22，选A

question: A researcher investigated two species of mites: a predator and its prey. At the start of a week, there was an equal number of the two species. At the end of the week, the number of prey had increased by 2400% of the number of prey at the start of the week, and the number of predators had increased by 450% of the number of predators at the start of the week. The number of predators at the end of the week was p% less than the number of prey at the end of the week. What is the value of p ?
explanations: 设捕食者和猎物的初始数量为a，则一周后猎物的数量为a(1+2400%)=25a，捕食者的数量为a(1+450%)=5.5a。(25a-5.5a)/25a=0.78=78%。因此p=78.

question:
