question:
When a landscape with native megafaunal (large-bodied) mammalian herbivores experiences a substantial decline in those populations, it loses a functional component of plant ecology. Introducing non-native proxy species has been beneficial in some such cases, but the reasonable concern persists that ecosystems may be negatively affected by species that didn’t coevolve with local vegetation. Scholarly analysis of findings from 221 studies revealed no evidence that nativeness mediates the ecological effects of megafauna, however, determining instead that other traits, such as diet selectivity, are more germane.

Which choice best states the function of the underlined portion in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It outlines the reasoning behind the claim about a benefit that is presented in the previous sentence.
B. It presents an insight suggesting that a concern acknowledged as sensible earlier in the text is unsubstantiated.
C. It explains why data do not show the expected pattern described at the beginning of the text.
D. It identifies an inconclusive finding that motivated a shift in the focus of an analysis discussed in the text.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
当一片拥有本土大型哺乳动物食草动物的景观经历这些种群大幅下降时，它就失去了植物生态学的一个功能组成部分。引入非本土代理物种在一些此类情况下是有益的，但合理的担忧仍然存在，即生态系统可能会受到未与当地植被共同进化的物种的负面影响。然而，对221项研究结果的学术分析显示，没有证据表明本土性介导了大型动物的生态效应，反而确定其他特征，如饮食选择性，更为相关。
中文解析：
划线部分通过研究结果指出“本土性”并非影响生态效应的关键因素，从而直接回应并质疑了前文中提出的“合理担忧”，表明该担忧缺乏证据支持。因此，选项B正确。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太第2&3套阅读语法（合并去重版）

question:
The following text is from Rachel Heng’s 2023 novel The Great Reclamation. Ah Boon is fishing off the coast of Singapore.
When he pulled up the nets, they contained only one kind of fish—black pomfrets, the flat diamonds of their bodies slick in the morning light. This uniformity did not surprise him; over the years, he’d learned that the waters here were temperamental. They could be relied upon for a good catch, but from time to time threw up only prawns or squid, and other times colorful varieties of fish that weren’t even supposed to be found in this region. He’d grown to accept the unpredictability, embracing it as a game to be played, like the reading of tea leaves or the grooves of a palm.

Taken together, the three underlined portions most clearly serve which function in the text as a whole?
selections: A. They illustrate the changeable nature of the fishing grounds where Ah Boon is.
B. They underscore Ah Boon’s lack of surprise at seeing sea creatures that aren’t usually found in the region.
C. They provide examples of what Ah Boon most frequently catches in the area.
D. They emphasize the wide variety of sea creatures that Ah Boon has caught on this particular fishing trip.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
当他拉起渔网时，网里只有一种鱼——黑鲳，它们扁平的菱形身体在晨光中滑溜溜的。这种单一性并不令他惊讶；这些年来，他已经了解到这片水域变化无常。它们通常能带来不错的收获，但有时只会捞到虾或鱿鱼，其他时候则是本不该出现在这个区域的彩色鱼类。他已经逐渐接受了这种不可预测性，将其视为一种游戏，如同解读茶叶或掌纹。
中文解析：
三个划线部分（即“通常能带来不错的收获”“有时只捞到虾或鱿鱼”“其他时候是不常见的彩色鱼类”）共同作为例子，具体说明了渔场“变化无常”的特性，因此选项A正确。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太第2&3套阅读语法（合并去重版）

question:
Rafael Núñez and colleagues studied how members of the Yupno, an Indigenous group in Papua New Guinea, conceptualize time in both spoken language and gestures. The researchers recorded Yupno speakers explaining certain temporal words and phrases, such as kalip bishap, a past oriented expression that translates to “past times,” and coded each speaker’s manual gestures. Previous research has found a tendency in many cultures to make temporal distinctions along imagined linear axes: for instance, Spanish speakers often refer to the left/right axis to describe events in time. Some researchers believe this tendency is universal, but Núñez and colleagues claim this is not the case.

Which finding, if true, would most directly support N úñez and colleagues’ claim?
selections: A. Yupno speakers typically use their left hand to make temporal gestures regardless of whether the gestures are east oriented or future oriented.
B. Some Yupno grammatical structures used when talking about time are also used in Spanish.
C. Future-oriented gestures used by Yupno speakers do not, on average, point in the opposite linear direction of past-oriented gestures.
D. Yupno speakers were observed making temporal gestures both indoors and outdoors, though with greater frequency when indoors.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
Rafael Núñez 及其同事研究了巴布亚新几内亚原住民 Yupno 人如何在口语和手势中概念化时间。研究人员记录了 Yupno 说话者解释某些时间词和短语（如 kalip bishap，一个指向过去的表达，翻译为“过去时光”）的过程，并对每位说话者的手势进行了编码。先前研究发现，许多文化中存在沿想象线性轴线区分时间的倾向：例如，西班牙语使用者常用左/右轴线来描述时间事件。一些研究者认为这种倾向是普遍的，但 Núñez 及其同事声称情况并非如此。
中文解析：
Núñez 的声称是“沿线性轴线区分时间并非普遍现象”。选项 C 指出 Yupno 人的未来导向手势并不平均指向与过去导向手势相反的线性方向，这直接表明他们未使用线性轴线来区分时间，从而支持了声称。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太第2&3套阅读语法（合并去重版）

question:
As jazz singer Sarah Vaughan honed her vocal abilities—acquiring a sophisticated timbre and precise control over pitch, dynamics, and _____ she earned comparisons to opera icon Leontyne Price, one of her personal heroes. The comparisons highlight how Vaughan, a jazz star, had transcended genre boundaries with her singing prowess.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 句子中的破折号用于引入一个解释性的插入成分，详细说明“声乐能力”的具体内容。为了使插入成分完整并与主句正确分隔，需要在插入成分结束时使用另一个破折号与之配对。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太第2&3套阅读语法（合并去重版）

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
●The Incarnations (2015) is an epistolary novel by English author Susan Barker.
●Epistolary novels are novels written primarily as a series of fictional documents.
●These documents can be letters, journal entries, newspaper clippings, and more.
●The Incarnations consists primarily of letters.
●The letters are sent between a taxi driver named Wang Jun and a mysterious woman.

The student wants to provide an example of an epistolary novel. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. In 2015, English author Susan Barker published a novel of letters sent between a taxi driver named Wang Jun and a mysterious woman.
B. Consisting primarily of letters sent between a taxi driver named Wang Jun and a mysterious woman, Susan Barker’s The Incarnations is an epistolary novel.
C. It was Susan Barker who published the novel The Incarnations in 2015.
D. An epistolary novel is a novel written primarily as a series of fictional documents, such as letters, journal entries, or newspaper clippings.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在研究一个主题时，一名学生记录了以下笔记：
●《轮回》（2015年）是英国作家苏珊·巴克的书信体小说。
●书信体小说主要是由一系列虚构文件构成的小说。
●这些文件可以是信件、日记条目、剪报等等。
●《轮回》主要由信件构成。
●这些信件是在一名叫王军的出租车司机和一名神秘女子之间往来传递的。
中文解析：
题目要求是“提供一个书信体小说的例子”。选项B明确指出了《轮回》是“书信体小说”，并有效结合了其核心特征（主要由信件构成）及信件人物关系，直接而完整地满足了要求；选项A虽然描述了小说内容，但未点明其体裁；选项C未提供体裁信息；选项D只给出了体裁定义，未提及具体小说实例。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太第2&3套阅读语法（合并去重版）

question:
On a chilly spring morning in a Virginia park, as sunlight crested the treetops, Kathrin Swoboda raised her Nikon D500 camera and captured an image that would win the Grand Prize in the 2019 Audubon Photography Awards: a red-winged blackbird, exhaling what appeared to be rings of smoke. ________ the “smoke” was actually the blackbird’s breath hitting the cold morning air as the bird sang.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在弗吉尼亚公园一个寒冷的春天早晨，阳光掠过树梢，Kathrin Swoboda举起她的尼康D500相机，捕捉到了一张赢得2019年奥杜邦摄影大赛大奖的照片：一只红翅黑鹂正在呼出看似烟圈的东西。因此，“烟”实际上是黑鹂唱歌时呼出的气息遇到寒冷晨空气所形成的。
中文解析：
前文描述照片看似鸟在吐烟圈，后文解释“烟”其实是鸟的呼吸遇冷空气形成的。两句之间存在一种“看似惊奇，实则理所当然”的转折或解释关系，即“当然/实际上”烟圈只是呼吸遇冷。“Of course,” 在此起到轻微转折与解释作用，符合语境逻辑。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太第2&3套阅读语法（合并去重版）

question:
Dating to around 1500, the Unicorn Tapestries are seven large tapestries depicting a unicorn hunt that hang in The Cloisters, a museum of medieval art in New York City. Attempting to explain the tapestries’ symbolism, art historian and former Cloisters head curator Margaret B._____ that while some have interpreted the tapestries as a Christian allegory, unicorns in that era were typically featured in secular rather than religious contexts.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 句子结构上，分词短语“Attempting to explain...”作为状语，需要主句有完整的谓语动词。选项D“Freeman noted”使“noted”作为谓语动词，引导宾语从句“that while...”。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太第2&3套阅读语法（合并去重版）

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
●A synthesis reaction is a type of chemical reaction.
●In a synthesis reaction, two or more substances combine to form a new substance.
●When sodium and chloride combine, they form a substance called sodium chloride.
●This substance is more commonly known as table salt.

The student wants to define the term “synthesis reaction.” Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. A synthesis reaction is a chemical reaction in which two or more substances combine to form a new substance.
B. A new substance is formed when a chemical reaction combines sodium and chloride.
C. The substance sodium chloride, also known as table salt, is formed by a chemical reaction.
D. When sodium and chloride combine, they form a substance commonly known as table salt.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在研究一个主题时，一位学生做了以下笔记：
●合成反应是一种化学反应类型。
●在合成反应中，两种或更多物质结合形成一种新物质。
●当钠和氯结合时，它们形成一种称为氯化钠的物质。
●这种物质更常被称为食盐。
中文解析：
题目要求定义术语。选项A直接概括了合成反应的普遍特征（“一种化学反应，其中两种或更多物质结合形成新物质”），符合定义要求。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太第2&3套阅读语法（合并去重版）

question:
KCUW-LP is a Native-run radio station broadcasting from the Umatilla Indian Reservation in Oregon. In 2004, Loris Taylor wanted to make sure that stations like KCUW-LP continued to thrive._____ she founded Native Public Media, a support system for Native radio stations that now includes around sixty stations.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
KCUW-LP 是一个由原住民运营的广播电台，从俄勒冈州的尤马蒂拉印第安保留区播出。2004年，洛里斯·泰勒希望确保像 KCUW-LP 这样的电台能够持续繁荣发展。因此，她创立了“原住民公共媒体”，这是一个为原住民广播电台提供支持的系统，现已涵盖约60家电台。
中文解析：
文本中，泰勒的目的（确保电台繁荣）与她采取的行动（创立支持组织）之间存在直接的因果关系。选项 C “Thus”
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太第2&3套阅读语法（合并去重版）

question:
Because of its bulky body, the world’s first airplane, the 1903 Wright Flyer, was not very aerodynamic. Modern planes, like the Northrop F-5 jet, have much sleeker, more streamlined bodies.______ they are much more aerodynamic.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
由于其笨重的机身，世界上第一架飞机——1903年的莱特飞行器——空气动力学性能不佳。而像诺斯罗普F-5喷气机这样的现代飞机，拥有更纤细、更流线型的机身，因此它们的空气动力学性能要好得多。
中文解析：
第一句指出早期飞机因“笨重机身”导致空气动力学性能差，第二句说明现代飞机因“更流线型机身”而空气动力学性能更佳，前后是明显的因果关系。选项D“For this reason”。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太第2&3套阅读语法（合并去重版）

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
●Documentary TV programs in the slow TV genre consist of uninterrupted broadcasts of ordinary events in real time.
●MORA: Zeichner is a German slow TV program.
●The 45-minute-long program documented an artist making a pencil drawing during a train journey.
●It first aired in 2016.
●Slow TV has been called “the world’s most boring television.”
●American journalist Nathan Heller praises it, writing that “it affords a visceral kind of armchair tourism.”

The student wants to use a quotation to refute the claim that slow TV programs are boring. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. With broadcasts of ordinary events, like artists at work, occurring in real time, slow TV just might be “the world’s most boring television.”
B. Far from boring, slow TV programs can provide a “visceral kind of armchair tourism,” as Heller puts it, whereby viewers can watch artists at work in real time.
C. MORA: Zeichner can afford a “visceral kind of armchair tourism,” as Heller puts it.
D. While some have praised slow TV for affording “a visceral kind of armchair tourism,” others have called it “the world’s most boring television”
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在研究一个主题时，一位学生做了以下笔记：
●慢电视类型的纪实电视节目由对普通事件实时不间断的广播组成。
●《MORA：绘图者》是一档德国慢电视节目。
●这档45分钟的节目记录了一位艺术家在火车旅行中绘制铅笔素描的过程。
●它于2016年首次播出。
●慢电视被称为“世界上最无聊的电视”。
●美国记者Nathan Heller赞扬它，写道“它提供了一种发自内心的扶手椅旅游”。
中文解析：
选项B以“远非无聊”直接反驳了无聊的说法，并引用了Heller的正面评价（“发自内心的扶手椅旅游”），同时结合了节目中艺术家实时工作的例子，从而有效地完成了反驳目标。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太第2&3套阅读语法（合并去重版）

question:
Vanadium is one of a variety of potentially useful trace elements contained in the chemical-rich brine that remains after seawater is purified through desalination. However, routine extraction of vanadium and other such elements from brine is not yet technologically or economically feasible. ________ most trace elements have only been extracted from seawater on an experimental basis.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
钒是海水淡化提纯后残留的、化学物质丰富的卤水中所含的多种有潜在利用价值的微量元素之一。然而，从卤水中常规提取钒及其他此类元素目前在技术上和经济上均不可行。______大多数微量元素仅是在实验基础上从海水中提取的。
中文解析：
前文指出提取技术的现实不可行性，后句说明大多数元素“仅在实验基础上被提取”，这实际上是延续前文、强调其尚处于非实用阶段的现状描述。“To date”（迄今为止）作为时间状语，最自然地衔接了两者间的逻辑关系。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太第2&3套阅读语法（合并去重版）

question:
In 1845, the United States District Court for the state of Iowa was established. Initially, the court’s jurisdiction was a single district that encompassed the entire state, but as Iowa’s population grew, this single district began to struggle to serve the needs of everyone in the state. ______ the court’s jurisdiction was subdivided into two districts, each with its own district court.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
1845年，美国爱荷华州联邦地区法院成立。最初，该法院的司法管辖区是覆盖整个州的单一司法区。但随着爱荷华州人口的增长，这个单一司法区开始难以满足全州人民的需求。最终，法院的管辖区被细分为两个司法区，每个区都设有自己的地区法院。
中文解析：
文本描述了因“人口增长”导致“单一司法区难以满足需求”这一问题，其后的结果是为了解决问题而采取了“细分辖区”的措施。前后构成“问题-解决方案”的因果与时间序列关系。选项A “Ultimately,”（最终）能最合理地表达这一措施是问题发展后采取的最终步骤或结果；
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太第2&3套阅读语法（合并去重版）

question:
●The Highpointers Club is a hiking club.
●One of the main goals among club members is to reach the highest points in all fifty US states.
●Those who achieve this are called 50 Completers.
●In Suk Han became a 50 Completer on November 15, 2013.
●The highest point in Wisconsin is Timms Hill, at 1,951 ft.
●The highest point in Wyoming is Gannett Peak, at 13,809 ft.

Which choice most effectively uses information from the given sentences to explain the 50 Completers hiking challenge to a new audience?
selections: A. If you are looking for a new hiking challenge, consider joining the Highpointers Club, as did In Suk Han, a hiker who successfully reached the highest point in every US state.

B. Not until after you have reached the highest points in all fifty US states—including Timms Hill in Wisconsin and Gannett Peak in Wyoming—can you include yourself among the 50 Completers of the Highpointers Club.
C. On November 15, 2013, In Suk Han finally completed the feat of reaching the highest point in all fifty US states, including Timms Hill in Wisconsin and Gannett Peak in Wyoming.
D. Hikers aiming to count themselves among the 50 Completers must reach not only West Virginia’s Spruce Knob but also the even higher peak of Mount Elbert in Colorado.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
●Highpointers Club 是一个徒步俱乐部。
●俱乐部成员的主要目标之一是到达美国所有50个州的最高点。
●实现此目标的人被称为“50 Completers”（50州完成者）。
●In Suk Han 于2013年11月15日成为一名“50 Completer”。
●威斯康星州的最高点是蒂姆斯山，海拔1,951英尺。
●怀俄明州的最高点是甘尼特峰，海拔13,809英尺。
中文解析：
题目要求向新受众解释“50 Completers”挑战，最有效的选项应同时包含挑战的定义、目标以及具体示例。选项B 完整说明了挑战规则（需到达所有50个州的最高点），并列举了威斯康星州和怀俄明州的例子作为具体说明，且明确了完成者称号与俱乐部名称，最符合要求。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太第2&3套阅读语法（合并去重版）

question:
As a defense mechanism, the monarch butterfly _______ toxic compounds from milkweed plants. On ingesting a piece of milkweed, the monarch selectively absorbs toxic cardenolides from the plant in its gut and stores them in the tissues throughout its body, rendering the butterfly unpalatable to predators.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
作为一种防御机制，帝王蝶会从马利筋植物中______有毒化合物。在摄入马利筋叶片后，帝王蝶会在肠道中有选择地吸收植物中的强心甾类毒素，并将其储存于全身组织中，从而使捕食者觉得这种蝴蝶难以下咽。
中文解析：
文段指出帝王蝶主动吸收并储存毒素以用于自卫，这是一种主动“利用”有毒化合物的策略，而非仅仅是中和、阻碍或分泌它们。exploits（利用）最贴合上下文对防御机制的解释逻辑。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太第2&3套阅读语法（合并去重版）

question:
The following text is from Yung Wing’s 1909 memoir My Life in China and America. Yung Wing was the first person from China to graduate from a US university.
Little did I realize when in 1845 I wrote, while in the Morrison School, a composition on “An Imaginary Voyage to New York and up the Hudson,” that I was to see New York in reality. This incident leads me to the reflection that sometimes our imagination foreshadows what lies uppermost in our minds and brings possibilities within the sphere of realities.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined sentence in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It explains the origin of Yung’s interest in writing.
B. It indicates Yung’s unwillingness to distinguish between reality and fantasy as a child
C. It illustrates the sense of adventure that Yung developed as a child.
D. It describes an event in Yung’s life that exemplifies a phenomenon.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
以下文字节选自容闳1909年的回忆录《我的中国和美国生活》。容闳是第一位从美国大学毕业的中国人。
1845年，我在马礼逊学校写了一篇作文，题为《假想航行至纽约并溯哈德逊河而上》，当时我完全没有想到自己会真的见到纽约。这件事让我想到，有时我们的想象预示了我们心中最深处的事物，并将可能性带进了现实范畴。
中文解析：
划线句子叙述了容闳少年时写作虚构游记而后成真的个人经历，这一具体事件为后文提出的普遍现象——“想象有时能预示内心所想并让可能变为现实”——提供了例证。因此，该句子在文中起到以个人经历引出并例证后文哲理的作用。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太第2&3套阅读语法（合并去重版）

question:
In the Metropolitan Museum of Art’s Costume Institute’s innovative multisensory exhibit of garments and accessories spanning four centuries, an emphasis on the ______ of fashion was conveyed both by the exhibit’s theme of perpetual renewal in nature and, more, subtly, by its scientific re-creations of ephemeral elements (like a fragrance worn with a dress more than a century ago).

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
大都会艺术博物馆服装学院举办了一场创新的多感官展览，展出了跨越四个世纪的服装与配饰。展览通过“自然永恒重生”的主题，以及更为微妙地通过科学重现转瞬即逝的元素（例如一个多世纪前与裙子搭配的香味），强调了时尚的______。
中文解析：
原文中“perpetual renewal”与“ephemeral elements”（短暂的元素）提示时尚具有短暂易逝的特性，且“transience”（短暂性）在逻辑上直接呼应“ephemeral”与“renewal”所体现的流转变化。其他选项（B.确定性；C.肤浅性；D.偏颇性）均与语境不符。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太第2&3套阅读语法（合并去重版）

question:
One notable feature of Southern US literature is its adaptation of established fiction genres to Southern contexts. Mark Twain derived his episodic narrative structures and roguish heroes from the picaresque novel, and William Faulkner realized the decadent aristocrat, the imperiled heroine, and other character types of the Gothic novel as rural Southerners who were more contingent, more caught in the net of societal relations and history than the fantastical figures of the Gothic had been. Some of the region’s poets, such as James Dickey, have shown even greater dexterity by adapting these sources in an altogether different literary form.

The text suggests that some Southern poets have adapted established fiction genres in different literary forms with Southern contexts. Which quotation would best serve as an example of this adaptation in the work of James Dickey?
selections: A. “With its rural settings and rustic characters, Dickey’s poems suggest the influence of the genre of pastoral action, yet Dickey may have instead obtained these elements from pastoral poetry, which preceded its namesake in fiction.”

B. “The Gothic genre emerged in England and Ireland in the 1700s and was later naturalized to the cultural landscape of the Northeastern US, as in the novels of Nathaniel Hawthorne, which Dickey had almost certainly read.”

C. “When Dickey invokes one genre of poetry and, within the space of a few lines, abandons it for another genre of poetry, what can we infer from this gesture if not the poet’s fascination with genre per se, as well as his discomfort with it?”

D. “What is the disturbed, and disturbing, speaker of Dickey’s best poems if not a stock character of the Gothic novel, refracted through the speech and ethos of the South and conditioned by the structures of lyric poetry?”
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
美国南方文学的一个显著特征，是对已有小说类型进行南方化的改造。马克·吐温从他的流浪汉小说中汲取了分段叙事结构和痞子英雄形象，威廉·福克纳则将哥特小说中的堕落贵族、身陷危局的女主角及其他人物类型，实现为更具现实性、更受社会关系与历史网络束缚的南方乡下人，而非哥特小说中那种奇幻角色。该地区的一些诗人，如詹姆斯·迪基，甚至通过以完全不同的文学形式改造这些源头，展现出更出色的技巧。
中文解析：
本文认为南方诗人能将传统小说体裁（如哥特小说）融入南方语境，并转化为诗歌形式。选项D明确指出迪基诗中“令人不安的叙述者”其实就是哥特小说中的典型角色，但经过“南方语言与精神的折射”以及“抒情诗结构的制约”，这完美对应了文本所说的“以不同文学形式改编来源”并赋予“南方语境”。其他选项或未提及文学形式转换，或未联系南方背景，故D为正确答案。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太第2&3套阅读语法（合并去重版）

question:
Guadalupe Romero Villanueva et al. conducted radiocarbon analysis of paint used in rock art at the Patagonian archaeological site Cueva Huenul 1, revealing that images of a comblike motif date to as early as 8,000 years ago, predating other paintings in the region by several millennia. The motif was subsequently reproduced multiple times at the site over the next 3,000 years, a period coinciding with extremely arid conditions and slightly negative population growth. The motif may therefore have functioned to help preserve cultural knowledge during a time of ecological and demographic stress.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined portion in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It emphasizes the historical conditions that explain why production of the painted motif described in the text abruptly ceased after 3,000 years of continue use.
B. It provides context that informs the text’s claim about why the peoples of Patagonia chose Cueva Huenul 1 as a culturally significant site.
C. It explains the environmental circumstances that account for the rarity of rock art dating to the same period as the most discussed in the text.
D. It identifies a consideration that factored into an interpretation of the rock art at Cueva Huenul 1 that is presented in the text.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
Guadalupe Romero Villanueva等人对巴塔哥尼亚考古遗址Cueva Huenul 1的岩石绘画颜料进行了放射性碳分析，发现梳状图案的图像可追溯到8000年前，比该地区其他绘画早了几千年。在接下来的3000年里，这一图案在该遗址被多次重复绘制，这一时期恰逢极端干旱条件与人口轻微负增长。因此，这一图案可能在生态与人口压力时期起到了帮助保存文化知识的作用。
中文解析：
划线部分描述了该图案被重复绘制的时期具有极端干旱与人口负增长的特征，这为后文解释其功能——在生态与人口压力下保存文化知识——提供了关键背景依据。因此，该部分的作用是点明影响岩画解读的一个具体历史条件。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太第2&3套阅读语法（合并去重版）

question:
Most Native languages belong to language families, or groups of languages whose similarities in vocabulary and grammar suggest shared descent from a single language spoken long ago. In contrast, the language spoken by the Yana people in a mountainous area of Northern California was an isolate, or a language with no demonstrated relationship to other languages. Isolates are more prevalent in mountainous regions than elsewhere, likely because challenging terrain inhibits the geographical expansion of language families. Yet it is clear that geographical barriers on their own cannot fully explain this aspect of the distribution of Indigenous languages in California and elsewhere in the present-day United States.

Which statement, if true, would most directly support the claim in the underlined sentence?
selections: A. Shoshone, a language in the Uto-Aztecan family, was originally spoken in a vast expanse of Idaho, Nevada, Oregon, and Wyoming—a region whose mountainousness rivals that of the homeland of the Yana people.
B. In mountainous regions of the western US, isolate-speaking peoples historically met most of their food needs through foraging, hunting, and fishing rather than intensive farming.
C. Although Native languages in non-mountainous areas of California tend to belong to language families, those families do not necessarily share common linguistic ancestry.

D. Yana and other isolates spoken in mountainous regions of California tend to contain many more terms describing features of mountainous terrain than nonisolate languages from relatively flat regions of California do.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
语言群体在词汇和语法上的相似性表明它们源于很久以前的一种共同原始语言。相比之下，北加利福尼亚山区亚纳人所使用的语言是孤立语言，即与其他语言无已知亲缘关系的语言。孤立语言在山区比其他地区更为普遍，可能因为复杂的地形阻碍了语系的地理扩张。然而很明显，仅凭地理障碍本身并不能完全解释加利福尼亚以及当今美国其他地区土著语言的这种分布特点。
中文解析：
文章指出山区虽然容易产生语言孤立现象，但单凭地理障碍并不能完全解释美国原住民语言的分布。选项A以肖肖尼语为例，说明即使在与亚纳人地区同等崎岖的山地环境中，仍然存在属于广泛语系（犹他-阿兹特克语系）的语言，从而质疑了“山地必然导致语言孤立”的简单推论，与原文的辩证逻辑相呼应。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太第2&3套阅读语法（合并去重版）

question:
The synthesis of novel superheavy elements, such as moscovium (Mc), has led theorists to consider the feasibility of synthesizing all possible chemical compounds. In 2022, Guillermo Restrepo calculated the historical rates at which newly discovered compounds have entered the scientific literature, expanding the “chemical space.” Using a conservative estimate of the number of viable compounds and assuming a doubling of the historical pace of discovery, Restrepo found that under these hypothetical conditions, all potential compounds could be synthesized and documented by 2050.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined portion in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It makes a comparison between the past and current rates at which new chemical compounds have entered the scientific literature.
B. It emphasizes the point implicitly made earlier in the text that human inefficiency is the primary constraint on the expansion of the chemical space.
C. It provides details about the qualification later in the sentence regarding the prospect of cataloging the full range of possible chemical compounds.
D. It introduces information that helps explain why the synthesis of superheavy elements has rapidly expanded the chemical space.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
新超重元素（如莫斯科元素，Mc）的合成促使理论学家思考合成所有可能的化学化合物的可行性。2022年，Guillermo Restrepo 计算了新发现的化合物进入科学文献的历史速率，从而扩展了“化学空间”。通过对可行化合物的数量采用保守估计，并假设发现速度比历史速率提高一倍，Restrepo 发现，在这些假设条件下，到2050年，所有潜在的化合物都有可能被合成并记录下来。
中文解析：
划线部分详细说明了 Restrepo 计算时所采用的条件（保守估计的可行化合物数量与假设翻倍的发现速率），这些条件正是后文中“到2050年可能合成并记录所有化合物”这一预测的重要前提。因此，该部分的作用是补充说明得出最终结论时所依据的假设与限定条件。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太第2&3套阅读语法（合并去重版）

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
●Atsuto Suzuki is a Japanese particle physicist.
●Particle physicists study subatomic particles.
●Neutrinos are some of the least understood subatomic particles.
●Neutrinos were first discovered in the mid-twentieth century.
●Suzuki is known for his discovery of geoantineutrinos.

The student wants to provide an example of a particle physicist whose research focuses on neutrinos. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. The research done on geoantineutrinos exemplifies the work particle physicists do to advance our understanding of subatomic particles.
B. Neutrinos are a type of subatomic particle that particle physicists are still trying to understand.
C. Particle physicist Atsuto Suzuki is known for his discovery of geoantineutrinos.
D. By studying geoantineutrinos—to name just one example—particle physicists can learn more about neutrinos.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在研究一个主题时，一位学生记下了以下信息：
●铃木厚人是日本粒子物理学家。
●粒子物理学家研究亚原子粒子。
●中微子是最不易理解的亚原子粒子之一。
●中微子首次发现于20世纪中期。
●铃木以其对地球反中微子的发现而闻名。
中文解析：
该选项直接点明研究对象为粒子物理学家铃木厚人，并指出其因发现地球反中微子而闻名。地球反中微子属于中微子的一类，因此该例正好符合“研究中微子的粒子物理学家”的要求，信息准确且简洁聚焦。其他选项要么未明确指出具体研究者，要么未明确将研究者与中微子研究挂钩。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太第2&3套阅读语法（合并去重版）

question:
Studying animals in a laboratory allows variables to be systematically controlled, but removing animals from their wild habitats can affect their behavior and biology in unforeseen ways. Given this, biologists Rebecca M. Calisi-Rodríguez and George E. Bentley examined research on brown-throated three-toed sloths and white-throated sparrows to see whether results from studies in the wild were consistent with the results of studies in the laboratory. Therefore, data showing that brown-throated three-toed sloths tend to sleep fewer than 10 hours per day in the wild would be irrelevant to Calisi-Rodríguez and Bentley’s investigation if _______

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. they tend to sleep more than 15 hours per day in the lab.
B. white-throated sparrows have low levels of corticosterone hormones outside of the breading season in the wild.
C. this behavior pattern has not been studied in the lab.
D. such data have been collected for white-throated sparrows in laboratory settings but not in the wild.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在实验室中研究动物能系统地控制变量，但将动物从其野生栖息地移出可能会以不可预见的方式影响它们的行为和生理。鉴于此，生物学家 Rebecca M. Calisi-Rodríguez 和 George E. Bentley 对棕喉三趾树懒和白喉带鹀的研究进行了调查，以判断野外研究的结果是否与实验室研究的结果一致。因此，若______，则表明棕喉三趾树懒在野外倾向于每天睡眠少于 10 小时的数据将与 Calisi-Rodríguez 和 Bentley 的调查无关。
中文解析：
题干核心在于比较同一种动物在野外与实验室的行为差异。若要判断野外数据是否与两位研究者的调查有关，必须存在对应的实验室数据可供比较。若该行为（睡眠时长）未在实验室中研究过，则无法进行对比，因此相关野外数据对调查无意义。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太第2&3套阅读语法（合并去重版）

question:
Born in Lyon, Mississippi, in 1902, musician Edward James “Son” House is best known as a key figure in the development of the Delta blues, a variant of blues that originated in the Mississippi Delta region. ______ steeped in the fertile music scene that sprung up in the alluvial delta between the Mississippi and Yazoo Rivers, House and his peers developed their distinctive stripped-down, guitar-driven style.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
音乐家爱德华·詹姆斯“桑”·豪斯于1902年出生于密西西比州里昂市，以作为三角洲布鲁斯发展的关键人物而闻名。三角洲布鲁斯是起源于密西西比河三角洲地区的一种布鲁斯变体。______沉浸在密西西比河与亚祖河之间冲积三角洲兴起的丰富音乐氛围中，豪斯及其同辈人发展出他们独特的简约、以吉他驱动的风格。
中文解析：
该句具体描述豪斯在三角洲地区受音乐环境影响形成其风格的过程。“There”指代前文提到的“密西西比三角洲地区”，既能衔接地点，又能自然引出其音乐风格形成的环境背景，逻辑连贯且过渡清晰。

explanations: 将x=9带入函数<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mn>8</mn><mrow><mn>11</mn><mo>−</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow></mfrac></math>，计算得f(9)=4。

question: A circle in the xy-plane has its center at <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mo>−</mo> <mn>7</mn> <mo>,</mo> <mn>2</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>, and the point <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>1</mn> <mo>,</mo> <mo>−</mo> <mn>2</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>  lies on the circle. Which equation represents this circle?
selections: A. <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>7</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>+</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>y</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>2</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>=</mo> <mn>80</mn></math>

B. <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>7</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>+</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>y</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>2</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mo>−</mo> <mn>2</mn> </mrow> </msup> <mo>=</mo> <mn>36</mn></math>

C. <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>7</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>+</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>y</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>2</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>=</mo> <mn>80</mn></math>

D. <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>7</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>+</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>y</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>2</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>=</mo> <mn>36</mn></math>
explanations: 因为圆心为(-7, 2)，设圆的方程为<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mo>−</mo> <mn>7</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>+</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>2</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>=</mo> <msup> <mi>r</mi> <mn>2</mn> </msup></math>。带入点(1, -2)，解得<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <msup> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mi mathvariant="normal">r</mi> </mrow> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>=</mo> <mn>80</mn></math>。选A。

question: On January 1, there were 236 views of a video posted on a social media site. Every 3 days after January 1, the number of views of the video had increased by <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>60</mn> <mi mathvariant="normal">%</mi></math> of the number of views 3 days earlier. The function f gives the predicted number of views x days after January 1. Which equation defines f?
selections: A. <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>f</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mn>236</mn> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>0.60</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mfrac> <mi>x</mi> <mn>3</mn> </mfrac> </mrow> </msup></math>

B. <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>f</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mn>236</mn> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>0.60</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mn>3</mn> <mi>x</mi> </mrow> </msup></math>

C. <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>f</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mn>236</mn> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>1.60</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mfrac> <mi>x</mi> <mn>3</mn> </mfrac> </mrow> </msup></math>

D. <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>f</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mn>236</mn> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>1.60</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mn>3</mn> <mi>x</mi> </mrow> </msup></math>
explanations: 当x=3时，观看数量为236(1+0.6)。当x=6时，观看数量为<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>236</mn> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>1</mn> <mo>+</mo> <mn>0.6</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>1</mn> <mo>+</mo> <mn>0.6</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mn>236</mn> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>1</mn> <mo>+</mo> <mn>0.6</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mn>2</mn> </msup></math>。以此类推，观看数量的函数为<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>236</mn> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>1</mn> <mo>+</mo> <mn>0.6</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mfrac> <mi>x</mi> <mn>3</mn> </mfrac> </mrow> </msup></math>,选C

question:

The equation gives a volume x, in gallons, of a <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>10</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">%</mi></math> saltwater solution that could be mixed with a volume y, in gallons, of a <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>20</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">%</mi></math> saltwater solution to produce an <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>18</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">%</mi></math> saltwater solution. According to this equation, what volume, in gallons, of the <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>20</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">%</mi></math> saltwater solution could be mixed with 45.0 gallons of the <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>10</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">%</mi></math> saltwater solution to produce an <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>18</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">%</mi></math> altwater solution? A dance studio charges an introductory fee for the first 3 lessons and then charges a fixed fee for each additional lesson. One student took 4 lessons and was charged $60. Another student took 16 lessons and was charged <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi mathvariant="normal">$</mi> <mn>300</mn></math>. Which function, f gives the total charge, in dollars, for any student who took x lessons, where <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>x</mi> <mo>></mo> <mn>2</mn></math>?
explanations: 设前3节课程的费用为a，每节额外课程的费用为b。从题中可得，a+b=60和a+13b=300。解出a=40，b=20。因此上x节课程的费用为40+20(x-3)=20x-20。选D。

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>3</mn></math>

The functions f and g are given. In function g, r is a constant. If <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>⋅</mo><mi>g</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>7</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>3</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>189</mn></math> , what is the value of r?
explanations: 化简<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>⋅</mo><mi>g</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>，得到<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>7</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>3</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>21</mn><mo>−</mo><mi>r</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>63</mn><mo>−</mo><mn>3</mn><mi>r</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>189</mn></math>,与<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>7</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>3</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>189</mn></math>进行对比，有21-r=0。所以r=21。

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><mrow><mo>−</mo><mn>22</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>29</mn><mo>+</mo><mi>m</mi></mrow><mn>2</mn></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mi>k</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>5</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>
In the given equation, k and m are constants. The equation has infinitely many solutions. What is the value of m?
explanations: 等式左右两边均为一次函数，函数图像为直线。等式有无穷多个解意味着两条直线有无穷多个交点，因此两条直线应该重合，即等式左右两边的函数为同一函数。所以<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>k</mi><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mo>−</mo><mn>22</mn></mrow><mn>2</mn></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>11</mn></math>，将k=-11带入<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>5</mn><mi>k</mi><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mo>−</mo><mn>29</mn><mo>+</mo><mi>m</mi></mrow><mn>2</mn></mfrac></math>，解出m=-81。选D。

question:

question: A right circular cylinder has a volume of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>35</mn> <mo>,</mo> <mn>152</mn> <mi>π</mi></math>  cubic inches. The height of the cylinder is 2 times its radius. What is the radius, in inches, of the cylinder?

question: One of the factors of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>8</mn> <msup> <mi>x</mi> <mn>4</mn> </msup> <mo>+</mo> <mn>50</mn> <msup> <mi>x</mi> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>+</mo> <mn>63</mn></math> is <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>a</mi> <msup> <mi>x</mi> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>+</mo> <mi>b</mi></math>,where a and b are positive constants. Which of the following is a possible value of ab?
explanations: 设另一个因式为<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <msup> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mi data-mjx-auto-op="false">cx</mi> </mrow> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>+</mo> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mi mathvariant="normal">d</mi> </mrow></math>,因此<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"> <mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo> <mi>a</mi> <msup> <mi>x</mi> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>+</mo> <mi>b</mi> <mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo> </mrow> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"> <mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo> <mi>c</mi> <msup> <mi>x</mi> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>+</mo> <mi>d</mi> <mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo> </mrow> <mo>=</mo> <mn>8</mn> <msup> <mi>x</mi> <mn>4</mn> </msup> <mo>+</mo> <mn>50</mn> <msup> <mi>x</mi> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>+</mo> <mn>63</mn></math>,比较系数得到ac=8，ad+bc=50，bd=63。(a, c)可能为(1, 8), (2, 4), (4, 2), 或(8, 1)。(b, d)可能为(1, 63), (3, 21), (7, 9), (9, 7), (21, 3), 或(63, 1)。因为ad+bc=50，所以a=2, c=4, b=9, d=7或者a=4, c=2, b=7, d=9满足条件，ab=18或28。选C。

In the xy-plane, the graph of  <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>y</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mi>f</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math> contains the points <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>0</mn> <mo>,</mo> <mn>36</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math> and <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>2</mn> <mo>,</mo> <mi>p</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>19</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>,where p is a constant. What is the value of p?
explanations: 将点(0, 36)带入函数<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>f</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <msup> <mn>20</mn> <mi>x</mi> </msup> <mo>+</mo> <mi>b</mi></math>,解得b=35。将点(2, p+19)带入函数<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>f</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <msup> <mn>20</mn> <mi>x</mi> </msup> <mo>+</mo> <mn>35</mn> <mo>,</mo></math>,解得p=416。

question:
Two participants solved a puzzle cube during timed competitions. The lists give the times, to the nearest second, that participant A and participant B took to solve the cube at various competitions.
Participant A: 23, 23, 25, 27
Participant B: 23, 23, 25, 27, 38
Which statement correctly compares the mean solve times, to the nearest second, of participant A and participant B at these competitions?
selections: A. The mean solve time of participant A is greater than the mean solve time of participant B.
B. The mean solve time of participant A is less than the mean solve time of participant B.
C. The mean solve time of participant A is equal to the mean solve time of participant B.
D. There is not enough information to compare the mean solve times of participant A and participant B.

question: If <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mfrac> <mrow> <mn>9</mn> <mi>x</mi> </mrow> <mn>2</mn> </mfrac> <mo>−</mo> <mn>11</mn> <mo>=</mo> <mfrac> <mn>45</mn> <mn>2</mn> </mfrac> <mo>−</mo> <mn>11</mn></math>, what is the value of 9x?
explanations: 等式两边同时加上11得到<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mfrac> <mrow> <mn>9</mn> <mi>x</mi> </mrow> <mn>2</mn> </mfrac> <mo>=</mo> <mfrac> <mn>45</mn> <mn>2</mn> </mfrac></math>,因此9x=45。选C。

question: The height of a right circular cylinder is 36 inches, and the circumference of its base is 360 inches. Which expression represents the total surface area, in square inches, of the cylinder?
selections: A. <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>36</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>360</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>+</mo> <mn>2</mn> <mi>π</mi> <msup> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"> <mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo> <mfrac> <mn>180</mn> <mi>π</mi> </mfrac> <mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo> </mrow> <mn>2</mn> </msup></math>

B. <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>36</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>360</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>+</mo> <mi>π</mi> <msup> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"> <mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo> <mfrac> <mn>180</mn> <mi>π</mi> </mfrac> <mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo> </mrow> <mn>2</mn> </msup></math>

C. <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>π</mi> <msup> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"> <mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo> <mfrac> <mn>180</mn> <mi>π</mi> </mfrac> <mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo> </mrow> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>36</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>

D. <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>36</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>360</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>
explanations: 侧面面积为(36)(360)。底面半径为<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mfrac> <mn>360</mn> <mrow> <mn>2</mn> <mi>π</mi> </mrow> </mfrac></math>,底面面积为,<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>π</mi> <msup> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"> <mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo> <mfrac> <mn>360</mn> <mrow> <mn>2</mn> <mi>π</mi> </mrow> </mfrac> <mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo> </mrow> <mn>2</mn> </msup></math>,总面积为<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>36</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>360</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>+</mo> <mn>2</mn> <mi>π</mi> <msup> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"> <mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo> <mfrac> <mn>360</mn> <mrow> <mn>2</mn> <mi>π</mi> </mrow> </mfrac> <mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo> </mrow> <mn>2</mn> </msup></math>,选A。

question: Which expression is equivalent to <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mfrac> <mrow> <mn>7</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>9</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>−</mo> <mn>2</mn> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>9</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> </mrow> <mrow> <mn>3</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>27</mn> </mrow> </mfrac></math>, where <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>x</mi> <mo>></mo> <mn>9</mn></math>?
explanations: <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mfrac> <mrow> <mn>7</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>9</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>−</mo> <mn>2</mn> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>9</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> </mrow> <mrow> <mn>3</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>27</mn> </mrow> </mfrac> <mo>=</mo> <mfrac> <mrow> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>7</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>2</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>9</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> </mrow> <mrow> <mn>3</mn> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>9</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> </mrow> </mfrac> <mo>=</mo> <mfrac> <mrow> <mn>7</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>2</mn> </mrow> <mn>3</mn> </mfrac></math>

question: The equation <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>5</mn><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mo stretchy="false">|</mo></mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>6</mn><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mo stretchy="false">|</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mi>k</mi></math>, where k is a constant, has exactly one solution. Which of the following could be the vaiue of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><mi>k</mi><mn>5</mn></mfrac></math>?
explanations: 因为5|x-6|=k，所以|x-6|=k/5。如果k/5>0，那么x有两个解(k/5)+6或(-k/5)+6。如果k/5<0，那么无解。如果k/5=0，只有一个解。选C。

question: In triangle XYZ, the measure of angle X is <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <msup> <mn>90</mn> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mo>∘</mo> </mrow> </msup></math>. Point W lies on segment YZ, and segment WX is perpendicular to segment YZ. The length of segment WY is 668, and the length of segment WX is 501. What is the value of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>tan</mi> <mo data-mjx-texclass="NONE">⁡</mo> <mi>Z</mi></math>？
explanations: 画出图形可以看出<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi mathvariant="normal">∠</mi> <mi>Z</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mi mathvariant="normal">∠</mi> <mi>W</mi> <mi>X</mi> <mi>Z</mi> <mo>=</mo> <msup> <mn>90</mn> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mo>∘</mo> </mrow> </msup></math>和<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi mathvariant="normal">∠</mi> <mi>W</mi> <mi>X</mi> <mi>Z</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mi mathvariant="normal">∠</mi> <mi>Y</mi> <mi>X</mi> <mi>W</mi> <mo>=</mo> <msup> <mn>90</mn> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mo>∘</mo> </mrow> </msup></math>， 因此∠Z=∠YXW。<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>tan</mi> <mo data-mjx-texclass="NONE">⁡</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi mathvariant="normal">∠</mi> <mi>Y</mi> <mi>X</mi> <mi>W</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mfrac> <mrow> <mi>Y</mi> <mi>W</mi> </mrow> <mrow> <mi>X</mi> <mi>W</mi> </mrow> </mfrac> <mo>=</mo> <mfrac> <mn>668</mn> <mn>501</mn> </mfrac> <mo>=</mo> <mfrac> <mn>4</mn> <mn>3</mn> </mfrac></math>,选D

question: The quadratic function g models the depth, in meters, below the surface of the water of a Weddell seal t minutes after the seal entered the water during a dive. The function estimates that the seal reached its maximum depth of 396.8 meters 8 minutes after it entered the water and then reached the surface of the water 16 minutes after it entered the water. Based on the function, what was the estimated depth, to the nearest meter, of the seal 11 minutes after it entered the water?
explanations: 抛物线的顶点为(8, 396.8)。设二次函数为<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>g</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>t</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mi>a</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>t</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>8</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>+</mo> <mn>396.8</mn></math>,带入点(16, 0)，解出a=-6.2。因此<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>g</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>t</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mo>−</mo> <mn>6.2</mn> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>t</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>8</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>+</mo> <mn>396.8</mn></math>,将t=11带入函数<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>g</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>t</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mo>−</mo> <mn>6.2</mn> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>t</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>8</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>+</mo> <mn>396.8</mn></math>,计算得出341。

question: In triangle ABC, the measure of angle B is <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <msup> <mn>90</mn> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mo>∘</mo> </mrow> </msup></math>  and BD is an altitude of the triangie. The rength of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mover> <mrow> <mi>A</mi> <mi>B</mi> </mrow> <mo accent="true">―</mo> </mover></math>  is 13 and the length of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mover> <mrow> <mi>A</mi> <mi>C</mi> </mrow> <mo accent="true">―</mo> </mover></math> is 19 greater than the length of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mover> <mrow> <mi>A</mi> <mi>B</mi> </mrow> <mo accent="true">―</mo> </mover></math>. What is the value of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mfrac> <mrow> <mi>B</mi> <mi>C</mi> </mrow> <mrow> <mi>B</mi> <mi>D</mi> </mrow> </mfrac></math>?
explanations: <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mfrac> <mrow> <mi>B</mi> <mi>D</mi> </mrow> <mrow> <mi>B</mi> <mi>C</mi> </mrow> </mfrac> <mo>=</mo> <mi>sin</mi> <mo data-mjx-texclass="NONE">⁡</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>C</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>,另一方面，在三角形ABC中，<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>sin</mi> <mo data-mjx-texclass="NONE">⁡</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>C</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mfrac> <mn>13</mn> <mrow> <mn>13</mn> <mo>+</mo> <mn>19</mn> </mrow> </mfrac></math>,因此 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mfrac> <mrow> <mi>B</mi> <mi>D</mi> </mrow> <mrow> <mi>B</mi> <mi>C</mi> </mrow> </mfrac> <mo>=</mo> <mfrac> <mn>13</mn> <mrow> <mn>13</mn> <mo>+</mo> <mn>19</mn> </mrow> </mfrac> <mo>∘</mo> <mfrac> <mrow> <mi>B</mi> <mi>C</mi> </mrow> <mrow> <mi>B</mi> <mi>D</mi> </mrow> </mfrac> <mo>=</mo> <mfrac> <mn>32</mn> <mn>13</mn> </mfrac></math>,选D。

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>39</mn><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>n</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>39</mn><mi>y</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>39</mn><mi>n</mi></math>
One of the equations in a system of two linear equations is given, where n is a positive constant. The system has no solution. Which equation could be the second equation in this system?
explanations: 化简方程39(x-n)=39y+39n得到y=x-2n。图像为斜率为1的直线。如果线性方程系统没有接，那么它们的图像应为两条平行的直线，所以第二个线性方程的斜率为1。选项A和D的斜率为1。选项A的方程与题目给出的相同，因此选D。

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>N</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>000</mn><msup><mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"><mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo><mfrac><mn>3</mn><mn>2</mn></mfrac><mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo></mrow><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mfrac><mrow><mn>6</mn><mi>t</mi></mrow><mn>5</mn></mfrac></mrow></msup></math>
The function N gives the estimated number of bacteria in a growth medium t hours after a study began. According to the function, the number of bacteria is estimated to increase by <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>50</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">%</mi></math> every k minutes. What is the value of k?
explanations: k分钟等于k/60小时。当t=0，N=1000。当t=k/60，N=1000(1+0.5)。因此<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>1000</mn><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>0.5</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>1000</mn><msup><mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"><mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo><mfrac><mn>3</mn><mn>2</mn></mfrac><mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo></mrow><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"><mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo><mfrac><mn>6</mn><mn>5</mn></mfrac><mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo></mrow><mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"><mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo><mfrac><mi>k</mi><mn>60</mn></mfrac><mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo></mrow></mrow></msup></math>,所以<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>1</mn><mo>=</mo><mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"><mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo><mfrac><mn>6</mn><mn>5</mn></mfrac><mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo></mrow><mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"><mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo><mfrac><mi>k</mi><mn>60</mn></mfrac><mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo></mrow></math>,解得k=50。选B

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><msup><mi>y</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>6</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>10</mn><mi>y</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>4</mn><mi>n</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math>
The given equation represents circle A in the xy-plane, where n is a constant. Point <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>5</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>7</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math> lies on circle B, which has the same center but twice the diameter as circle A. What is the value of n?
explanations: 将圆方程配方成标准形式：<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>3</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>y</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>5</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>=</mo><mn>34</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>4</mn><mi>n</mi></math>,因此圆A的圆心为(3, 5)，半径为<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msqrt><mn>34</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>4</mn><mi>n</mi></msqrt></math>,因此圆B的圆心为(3, 5)，半径为<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>2</mn><msqrt><mn>34</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>4</mn><mi>n</mi></msqrt><mo>.</mo></math>,圆B的方程为：<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>3</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>y</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>5</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>=</mo><mn>4</mn><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>34</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>4</mn><mi>n</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>,带入点(5, 7)，解出n=-8。

question: What value of p is the solution to the equation <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>8</mn> <mi>p</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>9</mn> <mi>p</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mn>8</mn></math>?
explanations: 因为8p-9p=8，所以-p=8，即p=-8，选A。

question: The function h is defined by <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>h</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mn>100</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>80</mn></math>. What is the value of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>h</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math> when <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>x</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mn>4</mn></math>?
explanations: 将x=4带入函数h(x)=100x-80，计算得320。选B。

question: The predicted population of a city x years after 1982, where <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>x</mi> <mo>≤</mo> <mn>10</mn></math>, can be modeled by the function <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>f</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mn>47</mn> <mo>,</mo> <mn>000</mn> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>1.04</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mi>x</mi> </msup></math>. Which of the following is the best interpretation of the statement “ <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>f</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>6</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math> is approximately equal to 59,470” in this context?
selections: A. 6 years after 1982, the predicted population of the city is approximately 59,470 people.
B. 6 years after 1982, the population of the city is predicted to decrease by approximately 59,470 people.
C. Every 6 years after 1982, the population of the city is predicted to decrease by approximately 59,470 people.
D. Every 6 years after 1982, the population of the city is predicted to increase by approximately 59,470 people.
explanations: 因为x表示1982年之后的年数，所以f(6)是1982年之后6年的人口数量。选A。

question: The function f is defined by <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>f</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mn>2</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mi>b</mi></math>, where b is a constant and <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>f</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>5</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mn>4</mn></math>. selections: A. The reported margin of error would be lower

question:

question: Which of the following equations is the most appropriate exponential model for the data shown in the scatterplot?
explanations: 因为函数是增函数，排除A和C。将x=10带入B和D，计算得选项B的值更接近64.53。选B。

question: Triangle ABC is similar to triangle XYZ, where A, B, and C correspond to X, Y, and Z, respectively. In triangle ABC, the length of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mover> <mrow> <mi>A</mi> <mi>B</mi> </mrow> <mo accent="true">―</mo> </mover></math> is 130 and the length of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mover> <mrow> <mi>B</mi> <mi>C</mi> </mrow> <mo accent="true">―</mo> </mover></math> is 650. In triangle XYZ, the length of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mover> <mrow> <mi>Y</mi> <mi>Z</mi> </mrow> <mo accent="true">―</mo> </mover></math> is 70. What is the length of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mover> <mrow> <mi>X</mi> <mi>Y</mi> </mrow> <mo accent="true">―</mo> </mover></math>?
explanations: 因为三角形ABC与三角形XYZ相似，因此 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mfrac> <mrow> <mi>X</mi> <mi>Y</mi> </mrow> <mrow> <mi>A</mi> <mi>B</mi> </mrow> </mfrac> <mo>=</mo> <mfrac> <mrow> <mi>Y</mi> <mi>Z</mi> </mrow> <mrow> <mi>B</mi> <mi>C</mi> </mrow> </mfrac></math>，即 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mfrac> <mrow> <mi>X</mi> <mi>Y</mi> </mrow> <mn>130</mn> </mfrac> <mo>=</mo> <mfrac> <mn>70</mn> <mn>650</mn> </mfrac></math>。计算得XY=14。

question: For a party, 65 hamburger buns are needed. Hamburger buns are sold in packages of 12. What is the minimum number of packages that should be bought for the party?
explanations: 设需要买x包面包，则 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>12</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>≥</mo><mn>65</mn></math>。因为x是整数，所以取大于65/12的最小的整数，为6。

question: The length of a stony coral colony was estimated to be 210 centimeters at the beginning of a study. The length of this coral colony was estimated to increase at a rate of 8 centimeters per year. What was the estimated length, in centimeters, of this coral colony 10 years after the study began?
explanations: 珊瑚群得长度每年增加8厘米，10年增加10*8厘米，所以10年后的长度为210+10*8=290厘米，选C

question: In a soccer league, each team earns 1 point for each game the team plays that ends in a draw and 3 points for each game the team wins. A certain team in this league has earned 46 points. Which equation represents this situation, where d represents the number of games this team has played that ended in a draw and w represents the number of games this team has won?
explanations: 因为d为平局的数量且每个平局得1分，所以平局共得分d。因为w为赢局的数量且每个赢局得3分，所以赢局共得3w分。总分为d+3w，因此d+3w=46。选D。

question:

What is the greatest solution to the given equation?
explanations: 一元二次方程 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>a</mi><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mi>b</mi><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>c</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math> 的解为 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>X</mi><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mo>−</mo><mi>b</mi><mo>±</mo><msqrt><msup><mi>b</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>4</mn><mi>a</mi><mi>c</mi></msqrt></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn><mi>a</mi></mrow></mfrac></math>，因此题目中方程有两个解 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><mrow><mn>5</mn><mo>±</mo><msqrt><mn>105</mn></msqrt></mrow><mn>8</mn></mfrac></math>，其中 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><mrow><mn>5</mn><mo>+</mo><msqrt><mn>105</mn></msqrt></mrow><mn>8</mn></mfrac></math> 更大。选B

question: If <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mfrac> <mn>18</mn> <mi>x</mi> </mfrac> <mo>=</mo> <mn>4</mn> <mi>x</mi></math>, what is the value of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>4</mn> <msup> <mi>x</mi> <mn>2</mn> </msup></math>?
explanations: 将等式 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mfrac> <mn>48</mn> <mi>x</mi> </mfrac> <mo>=</mo> <mn>4</mn> <mi>x</mi></math> 两边同时乘x，得到 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>4</mn> <msup> <mi>x</mi> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>=</mo> <mn>48</mn></math>。选C。

question: For a linear relationship between x and y, the table gives three values of x and their corresponding values of y, where t is a constant. Which equation represents this relationship?
explanations: 斜率公式为 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><mrow><msub><mi>y</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>y</mi><mn>1</mn></msub></mrow><mrow><msub><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>x</mi><mn>1</mn></msub></mrow></mfrac></math>，用表中任意两点计算出斜率为23/17。设线性函数为 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mn>23</mn><mn>17</mn></mfrac><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>b</mi></math>，带入表中任意一点，得到线性函数为选项D。

question:
The weight of each object in two groups, A and B, was recorded. The histograms represent the distributions of weight, in grams, for the objects in groups A and B.
The mean weight of the objects in group A is equal to 2.9, and the mean weight of the objects in group B is equal to 7.9. Which of the following statements about the standard deviations of weight for the objects in these two groups is true?
selections: A. The standard deviation of weight for the objects in group A is less than the standard deviation of weight for the objects in group B.
B. The standard deviation of weight for the objects in group A is equal to the standard deviation of weight for the objects in group B.
C. The standard deviation of weight for the objects in group A is greater than the standard deviation of weight for the objects in group B.
D. There is not enough information to compare the standard deviations of weight for the objects in these two groups.
explanations:
A组的平均值2.9在柱形图最中间的柱内，中间三个柱共有3+2+3=8个物体，两端的两个柱有6+6=12个物体，所以远离平均值的物体比靠近平均值的物体多，标准差较大。
B组的平均值7.9在柱形图最中间的柱内，中间三个柱共有3+10+3=16个物体，两端的两个柱有2+2=4个物体，所以靠近平均值的物体比远离平均值的物体多，标准差较小。
因此A组的标准差大于B组的标准差，选C。

question: A right rectangular prism has a height of 24 inches. The length of the prism’s base is x inches, which is 10 inches more than the width of the prisms base. Which function V gives the volume of the prism, in cubic inches, in terms of the length of the prism’s base?
selections: A. <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>V</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>24</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>10</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>

B. <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>V</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>24</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>10</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>

C. <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>V</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mn>24</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>10</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>

D. <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>V</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mn>24</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>10</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>
explanations: 长方体底面的宽为x-10。长方体的体积公式为长*宽*高，所以此题中长方体的体积为x(x-10)(24)。选D。

question: Triangle TUV is dilated by a scale factor of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mn>2</mn></mfrac></math> to obtain triangle <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>T</mi><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mi data-mjx-alternate="1">′</mi></mrow></msup><msup><mi>U</mi><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mi data-mjx-alternate="1">′</mi></mrow></msup><msup><mi>V</mi><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mi data-mjx-alternate="1">′</mi></mrow></msup></math> (not shown), where T corresponds to <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mtext>T'</mtext></math> and U corresponds to <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>U</mi><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mi data-mjx-alternate="1">′</mi></mrow></msup></math>. What is the measure in degrees, of angle <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>V</mi><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mi data-mjx-alternate="1">′</mi></mrow></msup></math>?
explanations: 放大或缩小三角形只改变边的长度，角的大小不变，所以角V’等于角V，即角V’等于25度。

question: The graph of the equation <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>5</mn><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>n</mi><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup></math>, where n is an integer constant, is shown. question: If <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>2</mn> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>5</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mn>6</mn></math>, what is the value of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>5</mn> <mi>x</mi></math>?

question: At a hotel, guests used the pool for a total of t hours in March. explanations: <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mfrac> <mrow> <mn>3.49</mn> <mi>t</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mi>t</mi> </mrow> <mi>t</mi> </mfrac> <mo>=</mo> <mn>2.49</mn> <mo>=</mo> <mn>249</mn> <mi mathvariant="normal">%</mi></math>。选C。

question: Darrel has a blanket with an area of 110 square inches ( <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <msup> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mi data-mjx-auto-op="false">in</mi> </mrow> <mn>2</mn> </msup></math> ). explanations: 每块织物增加64平方英寸，x块增加64x平方英寸，总面积为110+64x，选C。

question:
