explanations: 将y=4x带入第二个方程5x-3y=-14，解出x=2。因此y=4x=8。所以x+y=10。选D。

question: If <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <msqrt> <mi>x</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>5</mn> </msqrt> <mo>=</mo> <mn>8</mn></math>, what is the value of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>5</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>?
explanations: 将等式两边平方 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <msqrt> <mi>x</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>5</mn> </msqrt> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>=</mo> <msup> <mn>8</mn> <mn>2</mn> </msup></math> 得x-5=64，选C。

question: Line p is defined by <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>2</mn> <mi>y</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>8</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mn>11</mn></math>. Line r is perpendicular to line p in the xy-plane. What is the slope of line r?
explanations: 如果两条直线互相垂直，那么它们的斜率的乘积为-1。将直线2y+8x=11写成斜截式: y=-4x+5.5，所以直线p的斜率为-4。因此直线r的斜率为1/4。选C。

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>g</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>a</mi></mrow><mrow><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>b</mi></mrow></mfrac></math>
The function g is defined by the given equation, where a and b are constants. In the xy-plane, the graph of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>g</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math> passes through the point <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>43</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>, and <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>g</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>43</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math>. What is the value of b?
explanations: 将点(0, 43)带入 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>g</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>a</mi></mrow><mrow><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>b</mi></mrow></mfrac></math>，计算得 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><mi>a</mi><mi>b</mi></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mn>43</mn></math>。将g(-43)=0带入 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>g</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>a</mi></mrow><mrow><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>b</mi></mrow></mfrac></math>，计算得 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>a</mi><mo>=</mo><msup><mn>43</mn><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>43</mn></math>。所以b=a/43=44。选A。

question: A figure has an area of 3,168 square inches. What is the area, in square feet, of this figure? (1 foot =12 inches)
explanations: 因为1英尺=12英寸，所以1平方英尺= <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <msup> <mn>12</mn> <mn>2</mn> </msup></math> 平方英寸。因此面积为 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mfrac> <mn>3168</mn> <msup> <mn>12</mn> <mn>2</mn> </msup> </mfrac> <mo>=</mo> <mn>22</mn></math> 平方英尺，选A。

question: The function h is defined by <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>h</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mn>7</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>14</mn></math>. The graph of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>y</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mi>h</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math> in the xy-plane has an x-intercept at <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>a</mi> <mo>,</mo> <mn>0</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math> and a y-intercept at <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>0</mn> <mo>,</mo> <mi>b</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>, where a and b are constants. What is the value of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>a</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mi>b</mi></math>?
explanations: 将点(a,0)带入函数中算出a=-2。将点(0, b)带入函数中算出b=14。因此a+b=12，选A。

question: Which expression is equivalent to <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mfrac> <mrow> <mn>3</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>8</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>−</mo> <mn>9</mn> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>8</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> </mrow> <mrow> <mn>2</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>16</mn> </mrow> </mfrac></math>, where <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>x</mi> <mo>></mo> <mn>8</mn></math>?
explanations: 分子和分母分别提取公因式x-8和2：<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mfrac> <mrow> <mn>3</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>8</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>−</mo> <mn>9</mn> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>8</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> </mrow> <mrow> <mn>2</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>16</mn> </mrow> </mfrac> <mo>=</mo> <mfrac> <mrow> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>3</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>9</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>8</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> </mrow> <mrow> <mn>2</mn> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>8</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> </mrow> </mfrac> <mo>=</mo> <mfrac> <mrow> <mn>3</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>9</mn> </mrow> <mn>2</mn> </mfrac></math>

question: The function <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>f</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>t</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mn>40</mn> <mo>,</mo> <mn>000</mn> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>2</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mfrac> <mi>t</mi> <mn>410</mn> </mfrac> </mrow> </msup></math> gives the number of bacteria in a population t minutes after an initial observation. How much time, in minutes, does it take for the number of bacteria in the population to double?
explanations: 当t=0时，有40000个细菌。设有细菌80000个，带入函数得 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>80000</mn> <mo>=</mo> <mn>40000</mn> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>2</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mfrac> <mi>t</mi> <mn>410</mn> </mfrac> </mrow> </msup></math>，所以t=410，选B。

question: A right circular cone has a volume of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>4</mn> <mo>,</mo> <mn>800</mn> <mi>π</mi></math> cubic centimeters and the area of its base is <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>1</mn> <mo>,</mo> <mn>600</mn> <mi>π</mi></math> square centimeters. What is the slant height, in centimeters, of this cone?
explanations: 圆锥的体积为 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mfrac> <mn>1</mn> <mn>3</mn> </mfrac></math> *底面面积*高。所以高为 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mfrac> <mrow> <mn>4800</mn> <mi>π</mi> <mo>×</mo> <mn>3</mn> </mrow> <mrow> <mn>1600</mn> <mi>π</mi> </mrow> </mfrac> <mo>=</mo> <mn>9</mn></math>。因为底面面积为 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>1600</mn> <mi>π</mi></math>，所以底面半径为40。斜高为 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <msqrt> <msup> <mn>9</mn> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>+</mo> <msup> <mn>40</mn> <mn>2</mn> </msup> </msqrt> <mo>=</mo> <mn>41</mn></math>。选D。

question: The function g is defined by <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>g</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mn>15</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>22</mn></math>. For what value of x does <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>g</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>−</mo> <mn>25</mn></math>?
explanations: 将g(x)=25带入函数g(x)=15x+22，计算得x=1/5。

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>r</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mi>q</mi><mi>r</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>r</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>55</mn></math>
In the given equation, q is an integer constant. The given equation has no real solutions. What is the largest possible value of q?
explanations:
化简题中的等式得 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mi mathvariant="normal">r</mi></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mi mathvariant="normal">q</mi></mrow><mo>−</mo><mn>2</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mi mathvariant="normal">r</mi></mrow><mo>+</mo><mn>55</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math>。当 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>b</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>4</mn><mi>a</mi><mi>c</mi><mo><</mo><mn>0</mn></math> 时，方程没有实数解。所以
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>q</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>2</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>∗</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>∗</mo><mn>55</mn><mo><</mo><mn>0</mn></math>，解出 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>2</mn><mo>−</mo><msqrt><mn>220</mn></msqrt><mo><</mo><mi>q</mi><mo><</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>+</mo><msqrt><mn>220</mn></msqrt></math>。q可取到的最大整数为16。

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mrow><mn>4</mn><mi>x</mi><mi>y</mi></mrow></mfrac><mo>+</mo><mi>x</mi><mi>y</mi><mi>z</mi><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mrow><mn>3</mn><mi>y</mi><mi>z</mi></mrow></mfrac></math>
In the given equation, x, y, and z are positive numbers. Which expression is equivalent to y?
explanations: 将等式两边同时乘以12xyz得 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>3</mn><mi>z</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>12</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><msup><mi>y</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><msup><mi>z</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>=</mo><mn>4</mn><mi>x</mi></math>，因为y>0，解出 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><msqrt><mfrac><mrow><mn>4</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>3</mn><mi>z</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>12</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><msup><mi>z</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow></mfrac></msqrt></math>。选B。

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>38</mn><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>n</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>38</mn><mi>y</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>38</mn><mi>n</mi></math>
One of the equations in a system of two linear equations is given, where n is a positive constant: The system has no solution. Which equation could be the second equation in this system?
explanations: 化简方程38(x-n)=38y+38n得到y=x-2n。图像为斜率为1的直线。如果线性方程系统没有解，那么它们的图像应为两条平行的直线，所以第二个线性方程的斜率为1。选项A和D的斜率为1。选项A的方程与题目给出的相同，因此选D。

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><msup><mi>y</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>10</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>8</mn><mi>y</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>14</mn><mi>n</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math>
The given equation represents circle A in the xy-plane, where n is a constant. Point <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>11</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>8</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math> lies on circle B, which has the same center but twice the diameter as circle A. What is the value of n?
explanations: 将圆方程配方成标准形式：<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>5</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>y</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>4</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>=</mo><mn>14</mn><mi>n</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>41</mn></math>。因此圆A的圆心为(5, 4)，半径为 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msqrt><mn>14</mn><mi>n</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>41</mn></msqrt></math>。所以圆B的圆心为(5, 4)，半径为 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>2</mn><msqrt><mn>14</mn><mi>n</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>41</mn></msqrt></math>。圆B的方程为 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>5</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>4</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>=</mo><mn>4</mn><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>14</mn><mi>n</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>41</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>。将点(11, 8)带入圆B的方程，计算得n=-2。

question: In triangle XYZ, the measure of angle X is <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <msup> <mn>90</mn> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mo>∘</mo> </mrow> </msup></math>. Point W lies on segment YZ, and segment WX is perpendicular to segment YZ. The length of segment WY is 612, and the length of segment WX is 459. What is the value of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>tan</mi> <mo data-mjx-texclass="NONE">⁡</mo> <mi>Z</mi></math>?
explanations: 在三角形XZW中，<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi mathvariant="normal">∠</mi> <mi>Z</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mi mathvariant="normal">∠</mi> <mi>Z</mi> <mi>X</mi> <mi>W</mi> <mo>=</mo> <msup> <mn>90</mn> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mo>∘</mo> </mrow> </msup></math>。因为 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi mathvariant="normal">∠</mi> <mi>Z</mi> <mi>X</mi> <mi>W</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mi mathvariant="normal">∠</mi> <mi>W</mi> <mi>X</mi> <mi>Y</mi> <mo>=</mo> <msup> <mn>90</mn> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mo>∘</mo> </mrow> </msup></math>，所以 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi mathvariant="normal">∠</mi> <mi>Z</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mi mathvariant="normal">∠</mi> <mi>W</mi> <mi>X</mi> <mi>Y</mi></math>。因此 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>tan</mi> <mo data-mjx-texclass="NONE">⁡</mo> <mi mathvariant="normal">∠</mi> <mi>Z</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mi>tan</mi> <mo data-mjx-texclass="NONE">⁡</mo> <mi mathvariant="normal">∠</mi> <mi>W</mi> <mi>X</mi> <mi>Y</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mfrac> <mn>612</mn> <mn>459</mn> </mfrac> <mo>=</mo> <mfrac> <mn>4</mn> <mn>3</mn> </mfrac></math>。选A。

question:
Smart watches and fitness trackers tend to rely on batteries that can’t be easily taken out and swapped for new ones. Environmental policy researcher Carl Dalhammar warns that because these gadgets can’t _______ without working batteries, once the batteries stop working, the devices are typically disposed of as trash.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
智能手表和健身追踪器往往依赖于不易拆卸和更换的电池。环境政策研究员Carl Dalhammar警告称，由于这些设备在没有工作电池的情况下无法______，一旦电池停止工作，这些设备通常就会被当作垃圾丢弃。
中文解析：
文段重点在于说明电池失效会导致设备无法使用，进而被丢弃。“function”直接表达“运行、运作”的含义，与“without working batteries”（没有正常工作的电池）搭配，清晰说明设备依赖电池才能工作的本质，符合上下文逻辑。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第2套M2-Easy-13道题（去重版）

question:
Fossils of ancient arthropods preserved in volcanic ash in Morocco have _______ similarities between ancient arthropods and modern ones, such as spiders. Detailed 3D images of the fossils allowed scientists to see features that look like features found in arthropod species living today.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在摩洛哥火山灰中保存的古节肢动物化石，揭示了古节肢动物与现代节肢动物（如蜘蛛）之间的相似性。这些化石的详细3D影像使科学家得以看到与现今生存的节肢动物物种中类似的特征。
中文解析：
原文描述化石研究展现了古代和现代节肢动物之间的相似之处，这一过程是对科学事实的呈现与揭示。选项D “revealed”准确表达了“化石证据使这些相似性得以显现”的逻辑，符合语境中由影像发现特征的科学推论过程。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第2套M2-Easy-13道题（去重版）

question:
In 1941, college student Ann White ______ an offer to train as a codebreaker for the US military, which was preparing for World War II.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 原句主句缺少谓语动词，因此选择“received”作为过去式动词，可直接构成“Ann White received an offer...”的完整主谓宾结构。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第2套M2-Easy-13道题（去重版）

question:
According to Portuguese researcher Isabel C.F.R. Ferreira, the cinnamic acid found in button mushrooms can protect human cells from damage.______ the acid combats free radicals, a type of unstable molecule that can harm healthy cells in the human body.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
根据葡萄牙研究人员 Isabel C.F.R. Ferreira 的观点，双孢蘑菇中含有的肉桂酸可以保护人体细胞免受损伤。______ 该酸能对抗自由基，而自由基是一种会损害人体健康细胞的不稳定分子。
中文解析：
前一句指出肉桂酸有保护细胞的作用，后句则具体说明其作用机制（对抗自由基），属于从一般到具体的解释关系。因此“Specifically”能准确表达这种细化说明的逻辑关系。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第2套M2-Easy-13道题（去重版）

question:
When, on January 9, 1987, Kay A. Orr _______ serving as the governor of Nebraska, she became the state’s first female chief executive.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 原句有明显过去时间状语“on January 9, 1987”，因此谓语动词必须使用过去式。“began”是“begin”的过去式。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第2套M2-Easy-13道题（去重版）

question:
·The Smolensk Planetarium in Smolensk, Russia, is home to a Foucault pendulum.
·The pendulum consists of a weighted ball that swings at the end of a roughly 12-meter-long cable.
·Like all Foucault pendulums, it dangles from a fixed point that ensures the swing path of the pendulum doesn’t change.
·To an observer, the swing path of a Foucault pendulum appears to change over time because Earth rotates beneath it.
·Foucault pendulums are used as a simple way to provide evidence of Earth’s rotation.

Which choice most effectively uses information from the given sentences to specify the length of the Foucault pendulum’s cable?
selections: A. With a swing path that appears to change over time, a Foucault pendulum provides evidence of Earth’s rotation.
B. The Foucault pendulum at the Smolensk Planetarium consists of a weighted ball and a cable.
C. Although the swing path of a Foucault pendulum doesn’t actually change, it appears to change due to Earth rotating beneath the pendulum.
D. The Foucault pendulum at the Smolensk Planetarium in Smolensk, Russia, includes a cable that is roughly 12 meters long.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
·俄罗斯斯摩棱斯克天文馆设有一个傅科摆。
·该摆由一个重球和一根长约12米的缆绳组成。
·与所有傅科摆一样，它悬挂在一个固定点上，确保摆的摆动路径不变。
·对观察者而言，傅科摆的摆动路径似乎随时间变化，这是因为地球在摆下自转。
·傅科摆被用作证明地球自转的一种简单方式。
中文解析：
题目明确要求“具体说明傅科摆缆绳的长度”，选项D直接引用了笔记中“a roughly 12-meter-long cable”这一关键信息，并完整指出了该摆所属的地点（斯摩棱斯克天文馆），准确且有针对性地完成了任务。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第2套M2-Easy-13道题（去重版）

question:
A student is writing a research paper on the global rise of the home video game industry during the 1970s and 1980s. The student is surprised by differences in the number of units sold by some systems compared to those sold by others. Most remarkably, the ______

Which choice most effectively uses data from the table to complete the statement?
selections: A. IBM PC sold approximately 18,600,000 units, whereas the TurboGrafx-16 sold only approximately 1,900,000 units.
B. IBM PC sold approximately 6,952,600 units. whereas the TurboGrafx-16 sold only approximately 2,650,000 units.
C. Game & Watch sold approximately 18,600,000 units, whereas the Atari 400/800 sold only approximately 1,900,000 units.
D. Game & Watch sold approximately 6,952,600 units, whereas the Atari 400/800 sold only approximately 2,650,000 units.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
一名学生正在撰写一篇关于20世纪70、80年代家用电子游戏产业全球兴起的研究论文。该学生对下列游戏系统的销售数量差异感到惊讶：
中文解析：
该选项正确引用了表格中Game & Watch（18,600,000台）与Atari 400/800（1,900,000台）的销售数据，两者均为游戏相关设备，且销量差异显著（约9.8倍），符合 “most remarkbly”的要求。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第2套M2-Easy-13道题（去重版）

question:
Skeletal muscles are attached to bones. One bone, the humerus, has a skeletal muscle attached to _______ called the brachialis.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 句子中“attached to _______”的空缺应指代前文“the humerus”（一块骨头），应用单数中性代词“it”。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第2套M2-Easy-13道题（去重版）

question:
The impala (Aepyceros melampus) has a species population of about 2,000,000 ______ less than that of the water buffalo (Bubalus. bubalis), which has a species population of roughly 172,000,000.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 此处需连接两个独立分句：“The impala... 2,000,000 members”与“this amount is less...”。符合标准英语规范且能正确连接两个独立分句的标点只有分号（;）
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第2套M2-Easy-13道题（去重版）

question:
Otake Chikuha’ s 1902 piece Fall of the Castle is an important work of Nihonga, or traditional Japanese painting. To produce the piece, Otake used a centuries-old Japanese approach, applying ink and watercolor to a silk surface. By contrast, Saeki  Yūzō _______ European methods, using oil on canvas to produce Western-style paintings.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
大竹赤坡1902年的作品《落城》是日本画（即传统日本绘画）的重要作品。为创作此作，大竹运用了延续数世纪的日本技法，在丝绢上施以水墨与水彩。相比之下，佐伯祐三______欧洲技法，使用油画布与油彩创作西式绘画。
中文解析：
此处将两位艺术家的创作方法进行对比：大竹使用日本传统技法，而佐伯祐三则使用欧洲技法。 "employed" 意为“采用、运用”，与前文“used a centuries-old Japanese approach”形成直接对照，精确表达了“使用某种方法或技术”的含义。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第2套M2-Easy-13道题（去重版）

question:
The following text is adapted from Jhumpa Lahiri’s 2003 novel The Namesake. Gogol is an elementary school student in Massachusetts.
In art class, his favorite hour of the week, he carves his name with paper clips into the bottoms of clay cups and bowls. He pastes uncooked pasta to cardboard, and leaves his signature in fat brush strokes below paintings.
©2003 by Jhumpa Lahiri

As used in the text, what does the word “carves” most nearly mean?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
以下文字改编自裘帕·拉希莉2003年的小说《同名人》。高戈尔是马萨诸塞州的一名小学生。
在艺术课上——这是他一周中最喜欢的时光——他用回形针在陶土杯子和碗的底部刻上自己的名字。他将未煮熟的意大利面粘贴到纸板上，并在画作下方用粗大的笔触留下自己的签名。
©2003 裘帕·拉希莉
中文解析：
文段描述高戈尔在艺术作品上留下名字的不同方式：先用回形针在陶器上刻名字，再用画笔在画作上签名。“carves”与后文的“signature”（签名）形成呼应，都指向在作品上留下个人标记的行为。因此，“carves”在此语境中最贴近“署名/刻写名字”的含义。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第2套M2-Easy-13道题（去重版）

question:
Blue holes, such as the Blue Hole of Gozo in the Maltese Islands, are large seawater sinkholes that tend to have varying water density and irregularities in their steep walls. In 2021, researchers studied the previously unexplored Taam Ja’ Blue Hole (TJBH) in Chetumal Bay, Mexico; using echo sounder mapping, they determined its maximum depth to be about 274 meters. In the complex environments of blue holes, however, echo sounder mapping has limitations. So, in 2023, Teresa Álvarez-Legorreta and colleagues employed a conductivity, temperature, and depth (CTD) profiler to remeasure the depth of the TJBH. The profiler recorded depths around 420 meters but was unable to confirm detection of the bottom of the hole, suggesting that _________

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. while the CTD profiler may be better suited than echo sounder mapping for measuring the depth of blue holes, another measurement approach is likely needed to ascertain the maximum depth of the TJBH.

B. while the CTD profiler can discern the properties of underwater terrains more comprehensively than echo sounder mapping can, echo sounder mapping produces more accurate measurements at greater underwater depths.
C. although the maximum depth of the TJBH has yet to be conclusively detected, the bottom of the hole is most likely between 274 and 420 meters below sea level.
D. although both echo sounder mapping and the CTD profiler have known limitations, they produce reliable estimates of the depth of blue holes when used together.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
蓝洞（如马耳他群岛戈佐岛蓝洞）是大型海水沉洞，往往具有变化的水体密度与陡峭内壁的不规则形态。2021年，研究人员研究了墨西哥切图马尔湾此前未被探索的塔姆贾蓝洞（TJBH），通过回声测深测绘确定其最大深度约为274米。然而在蓝洞的复杂环境中，回声测深测绘存在局限。因此，2023年Teresa Álvarez-Legorreta及其同事使用温盐深剖面仪（CTD）重新测量TJBH的深度。该仪器记录到约420米的深度，但未能确认探测到洞底，这表明________
中文解析：
文中指出CTD仪器虽然测到约420米，但“未能确认探测到洞底”，意味着当前方法仍无法确定最终深度。选项A据此提出“可能需要其他测量方法”，既承认CTD的改进，又指出其局限，与文本逻辑完全衔接。其他选项或与文中数据冲突，或提出缺乏依据的推测。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第2套M2-Easy-13道题（去重版）

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
·The Zambezi River is 1,703 kilometers long.
·It is in Africa.
·It ranks No.32 among the longest rivers in the world.
·The Vistula River is 754 kilometers long.
·It is in Europe.
·It ranks No.133 among the longest rivers in the world.

The student wants to indicate where the Zambezi River is located. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. The Vistula River is ranked No.133 among the longest rivers in the world
B. The Zambezi River is 1,703 kilometers long.
C. The Zambezi River is located in Africa.
D. The Zambezi and Vistula rivers are among the longest rivers in the world.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
一位学生在研究某主题时记录了以下信息：
·赞比西河全长1,703公里。
·位于非洲。
·在世界最长河流中排名第32位。
·维斯瓦河全长754公里。
·位于欧洲。
·在世界最长河流中排名第133位。
中文解析：
题目明确要求“说明赞比西河的位置”，选项C直接、准确地使用了笔记中“It is in Africa”这一信息，简洁地达成了目标。其他选项要么未提及位置，要么提及的是其他河流的信息，不符合题目要求。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第2套M2-Easy-13道题（去重版）

question:
Ethicist Ingrid Robeyns argues in her work that taxes on the very wealthy should be increased so that governments will be enabled to solve problems of collective action, such as mitigating climate change. Robeyns cites the work of economist Mariana Mazzucato, who shows that government subsidies are a more effective engine of innovation than private sector investments; in addition, government-funded innovations tend to lead to further developments in disparate fields (such as the United States mission to land a person on the Moon, which accelerated developments in nutrition as well as navigation).

Which choice best describes the overall structure of the text?
selections: A. It offers a claim by a scholar, then uses the results of a project by another scholar to show why that claim should be rejected.
B. It summarizes the research of one scholar, then presents a study by another scholar that was inspired by the findings of that research.
C. It details the findings of a research project by one scholar, then puts forward the suggestions of another scholar for further investigation.
D. It introduces a proposition by a scholar, then describes that scholar’s use of findings by another scholar to support that proposition.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
伦理学家英格丽德·罗贝恩斯在其著作中主张，应对极富阶层增税以使政府能够解决集体行动问题，例如缓解气候变化。罗贝恩斯引用了经济学家玛丽安娜·马祖卡托的研究，后者指出政府补贴是比私人部门投资更有效的创新引擎；此外，政府资助的创新往往能推动不同领域的进一步发展（例如美国的登月计划，就同时促进了营养学和导航技术的进步）。
中文解析：
文本首先提出罗贝恩斯的观点（对富人增税以支持政府解决集体行动问题），随后描述她引用另一位学者马祖卡托的研究结论来支撑自己的主张。选项D准确概括了这一“提出主张—引用他人研究加以支持”的结构。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第3套M2-Easy-9道题（去重版）

question:
Memoirs of Eleanor Eldridge is an 1838 historical account by Eleanor Eldridge and Frances Harriet Whipple Green. In the book, the authors caution against inquiring into the private life of the book’s subject beyond what is presented in the text, writing,_______

Which quotation from Memoirs of Eleanor Eldridge most effectively illustrates the claim?
selections: A. “Let us, dear reader, remember the punishment of idle curiosity, as taught in the true and affecting history [named] ‘Blue Beard’ and, striving to be content with the facts in the case, seek not to lift the veil, which the sensibility of true love, and feminine delicacy, have alike conspired to draw.”
B. “Home is home, to the lowly as well as the great; and no rank, or color, destroys its sacred character, its power over the mind, and the affections.”

C. “Having thus so comfortably established ourselves, with no evil-minded eaves-dropper to make us afraid, bend now, dear reader, thy most earnest and delicately adjusted ear, for I am going to tell thee a secret.”

D. “How careful ought we to be to speak nothing but the truth, even in regard to the most trifling circumstances; and not only so, but to be well assured that what we suppose to be true, is truth, before we receive it as such.”
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
《埃莉诺·埃尔德里奇回忆录》是埃莉诺·埃尔德里奇与弗朗西丝·哈里特·惠普尔·格林于1838年合著的历史记述。在书中，作者们告诫读者不要探究书中人物在文本内容之外的私生活，并写道：______
中文解析：
题目要求选择最能体现“作者告诫读者不要探究书中人物私生活”这一主张的引文。选项A明确提醒读者克制无谓的好奇心、满足于已知事实、不去揭开隐私的“面纱”，与题干的警告完全对应。选项B强调“家”的普遍意义，选项C则邀请读者倾听秘密，均不符合警告意图。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第3套M2-Easy-9道题（去重版）

question:
Through the process of photosynthesis, plants use sunlight, water, and carbon dioxide to create their own food. This amazing ability allows plants _____and provides oxygen for other living things to breathe.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 根据“allow sb. to do sth.”的固定搭配，应填入不定式“to grow”。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第3套M2-Easy-9道题（去重版）

question:
The following text is from Angeline Boulley’ s 2021 novel Firekeeper’s Daughter. The narrator is an Ojibwe teenager who runs in the morning before going to school. Levi is her younger brother.
My brother complains about my lengthy warm-up routine whenever he runs with me. I keep telling Levi that my longer, bigger, and therefore vastly superior muscles require more intensive preparation for peak performance. The real reason, which he would think is dorky, is that I recite the correct anatomical name for each muscle as I stretch.
©2021 by Angeline Boulley

What is the main topic of the text?
selections: A. The narrator’s warm-up routine before running
B. A high school teacher whose class the narrator enjoys
C. The career that the narrator’s brother hopes to pursue someday
D. The narrator’s feelings about moving to a new town
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
以下文字摘自安吉琳·布莱 2021 年小说《守火人之女》。叙述者是一名奥吉布瓦族青少年，她在上学前进行晨跑。莱维是她的弟弟。
每当弟弟和我一起跑步时，他总会抱怨我漫长的热身流程。我不断告诉莱维，我更长、更大因而也优秀得多的肌肉需要更充分的准备才能达到最佳表现。而真正的原因——他会觉得这很呆——是我会在伸展时背诵每块肌肉正确的解剖学名称。
中文解析：
文本主要围绕叙述者的热身习惯展开，包括弟弟的抱怨、她对外给出的借口以及真实原因。其他选项（B：喜欢的老师；C：弟弟的未来职业；D：搬家的感受）均未在文本中提及。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第3套M2-Easy-9道题（去重版）

question:
Volcanoes Active since 1800 and since 1960 in Two Countries
A student is collecting data about countries with volcanoes that have been active in the time since 1800 and in the time since 1960. The student records that Tonga has ____

Which choice most effectively uses data from the graph to complete the statement?
selections: A. no volcanoes that have been active since 1800.
B. the same number of volcanoes that have been active since 1800 as Ecuador has.
C. more volcanoes that have been active since 1960 than Ecuador has
D. fewer volcanoes that have been active since 1960 than Ecuador has.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
一名学生正在收集关于自1800年以来和自1960年以来有火山活动国家的数据。该学生记录到，汤加______。
中文解析：
从图表数据可知，汤加自1960年以来活跃的火山数量为3座，厄瓜多尔为6座。因此，汤加 少于 厄瓜多尔自1960年以来活跃的火山数量。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第3套M2-Easy-9道题（去重版）

question:
In Puerto Rico, it’s not unusual for a city or town to be known by a nickname that corresponds to one of its notable features, like landscape, ______ or chief exports. For example, the Puerto Rican municipality of San Sebastián has also been called “the Cradle of Hammocks,” a nickname that alludes to what the area is well known for: the woven hammocks its residents famously produce.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 句子中“like landscape, ______ or chief exports”为三者的并列结构，需用逗号分隔并列项。选项D在“climate”和“famous residents”后均使用逗号，使三者（landscape, climate, famous residents, or chief exports）清晰并列，语法正确。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第3套M2-Easy-9道题（去重版）

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
·A river’s stream length is the length of a line that follows along the river path.
·A river’s valley length is the length of a straight line drawn from the beginning of the river to the end.
·The river’s curviness, or sinuosity, is the ratio of the river’s stream length to its valley length.
·This ratio is less than or equal to 1.5:1 in low-sinuosity rivers and greater than 1.5:1 in high-sinuosity rivers.
·The Congaree River in the United States has high sinuosity. The Luni River in India has low sinuosity.

The student wants to compare the sinuosity of the Congaree and Luni rivers. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. In both the Congaree and the Luni rivers, sinuosity is determined by comparing stream length to valley length.
B. The ratio of the Congaree River’s stream length to its valley length is greater than 1.5:1, exceeding that of the Luni River.
C. By comparing the stream lengths of the Congaree and Luni rivers to their valley lengths, one can calculate their sinuosity.
D. While the high-sinuosity Congaree River is located in the United States, the Luni River is in India.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在研究一个主题时，一名学生做了以下笔记：
·河流的“河道长度”是沿河流路径测量得到的长度。
·河流的“河谷长度”是从河流起点到终点画一条直线的长度。
·河流的弯曲度（即曲率）是河道长度与河谷长度的比值。
·低曲率河流的该比值小于或等于1.5:1，高曲率河流的该比值大于1.5:1。
·美国的康加里河为高曲率河流，印度的卢尼河为低曲率河流。
中文解析：
题目要求比较两条河流的曲率。选项B直接指出康加里河的河道长度与河谷长度之比大于1.5:1，并明确其“超过”卢尼河（根据笔记，卢尼河比值≤1.5:1），清晰完成了比较目标。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第3套M2-Easy-9道题（去重版）

question:
One reasonable way to evaluate the ______ of a scholar’s research is to track how often other scholars refer to that research. For example, Deutsche Bundesbank economist Claudia M. Buch, who studies banking regulations, is among the world’s most frequently cited researchers in her specialty, indicating that her work has had a significant effect on the field.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
评价学者研究______的一个合理方法是追踪其他学者引用该研究的频率。例如，研究银行监管的德国联邦银行经济学家Claudia M. Buch是其专业领域内全球被引用最频繁的研究者之一，这表明她的工作对该领域产生了重要影响。
中文解析：
该段文字的核心逻辑是，用“其他学者的引用频率”作为评估标准，这显然是为了衡量一项研究对学术界产生的“影响”或“效果”。选项中只有A（impact）符合这一语境。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第3套M2-Easy-9道题（去重版）

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
·The Carnegie Prize is an international art competition.
·It is administered by the Carnegie Museum of Art in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania.
·One Carnegie Prize gold medal winner is Gaston La Touche of France.
·La Touche’ s painting The Bath was honored in 1907.

The student wants to indicate the name of the artist who created the prize-winning painting The Bath. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. The Carnegie Museum of Art in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, administers a competition honoring outstanding artworks.
B. In 1907, an artist from France won a Carnegie Prize gold medal.
C. The Carnegie Prize is an international art competition administered by the Carnegie Museum of Art.
D. The prize-winning painting The Bath is by the artist Gaston La Touche.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在研究一个主题时，一名学生做了以下笔记：
·卡内基奖是一项国际艺术竞赛。
·该奖项由位于宾夕法尼亚州匹兹堡的卡内基艺术博物馆管理。
·法国艺术家加斯顿·拉图什曾获得卡内基奖金牌。
·拉图什的画作《沐浴》于1907年获奖。
中文解析：
题目要求明确指出获奖画作《沐浴》的创作者是谁。选项D直接说明“获奖画作《沐浴》出自艺术家加斯顿·拉图什”。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第3套M2-Easy-9道题（去重版）

question:
The Apollo Moon landings (1969-1972) brought atmospheric sensors and soil sensors to the Moon and produced large amounts of data, much of which was stored on technologies that are now obsolete. A data-transfer project is working to ________ these data so that the information is available to researcher Noah Petro, who is investigating the geology of the Moon.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
阿波罗登月任务（1969-1972年）将大气传感器和土壤传感器带到月球，并产生了大量数据，其中许多数据存储在现已过时的技术中。一个数据转移项目正致力于________这些数据，以便研究月球地质的研究员诺亚·佩特罗能够获取这些信息。
中文解析：
数据存储在过时技术上，面临无法读取的风险，因此项目目的是“抢救”或“挽回”这些数据。选项A “salvage”（挽救、抢救）是正确答案。其他选项B“改进”、C“修正”、D“简化”均不符合语境，因为重点在于数据恢复而非优化或修改。

question:
Steve Carter’s award-winning play Eden was produced in 1976 by the groundbreaking Negro Ensemble Company (NEC). NEC cofounder Douglas Turner Ward, who worked as an actor, director, and playwright, had met actor and producer Robert Hooks while they were performing in a 1960 touring production of Lorraine Hansberry’s play A Raisin in the Sun. Together, they envisioned a theater company that would nurture and showcase the work of Black theater professionals. Since NEC’s founding in 1967, its workshops and performances have given Black playwrights, including Carter, a forum for their compelling stories.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined sentence in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It illustrates the widespread influence of a play discussed earlier in the text.
B. It provides additional information about a person mentioned in the text.
C. It emphasizes the ongoing significance of the theater company discussed in the text.
D. It explains the circumstances that led to the formation of the theater company discussed in the text.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
史蒂夫·卡特的获奖剧作《伊甸园》于1976年由开创性的黑人剧团公司（NEC）制作。NEC联合创始人道格拉斯·特纳·沃德（身兼演员、导演和剧作家）在1960年巡演洛兰·汉斯贝里的戏剧《阳光下的葡萄干》时结识了演员兼制作人罗伯特·胡克斯。他们共同设想建立一个能培养和展示黑人戏剧专业人士作品的剧院公司。自NEC于1967年成立以来，其工作坊和演出为包括卡特在内的黑人剧作家提供了一个展示他们引人入胜故事的平台。
中文解析：
该划线句描述了NEC自成立以来持续发挥的作用和影响，强调了该公司对黑人剧作家的长期支持与贡献，因此其功能是强调该剧院公司的持续重要性，对应选项C。

question:
The following text is from Mark Twain’s 1876 novel The Adventures of Tom Sawyer. Tom, a child, has been told by his aunt to paint their house’s fence.
Tom appeared on the sidewalk with a bucket of whitewash and a long-handled brush. He surveyed the fence, and all gladness left him and a deep melancholy settled down upon his spirit. Thirty yards of board fence nine feet high.

As used in the text, what does the word “surveyed” most nearly mean?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
汤姆提着一桶白涂料和一把长柄刷子出现在人行道上。他审视着篱笆，所有快乐顿时消失，深深的忧郁笼罩心头。这篱笆有三十码长，九英尺高。
中文解析：
在上下文中，“surveyed”描述汤姆仔细查看篱笆的样子，意为“检查”或“审视”，因此选项C“Examined”（检查）最贴切。其他选项（A转变、B组织、D保证）均不符合文意。

question:
In factories, humans and robots often work together. A research team ran an experiment to find out how working with robots affects relationships between human coworkers. The experiment included teams working together to make electric motor parts. One type of team included only humans and the other type included both humans and robots. Participants were paid for their work and were asked about their willingness to share their earnings with their human teammates. Participants from teams with robots were more likely to share with each other than participants from teams with only humans were.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined sentence in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It states the results of the experiment discussed in the text.
B. It indicates the question that the study discussed in the text was meant to answer.
C. It explains an important part of the design of the experiment discussed in the text.
D. It illustrates a problem that inspired the study discussed in the text.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在工厂中，人类和机器人经常一起工作。一个研究团队进行了一项实验，以找出与机器人一起工作如何影响人类同事之间的关系。实验包括团队合作制造电动马达零件。一种团队只有人类，另一种包括人类和机器人。参与者因工作获得报酬，并被问及他们是否愿意与人类队友分享收入。与机器人一起工作的参与者比只有人类的参与者更愿意彼此分享。
中文解析：
划线句子描述了实验设计中的参与者薪酬和共享意愿的衡量方式，属于实验方法的一部分，因此其作用是解释实验设计的重要环节，对应选项 C。

question:
The following text is adapted from the 1895 poem “Ojistoh” by Emily Pauline Johnson, a Kanienkahagen (Mohawk) writer also known as Tekahionwake.
I am Ojistoh, I am she, the wife
Of him whose name breathes bravery and life
And courage to the tribe who calls him chief.
I am Ojistoh, his white star, and he
Is land, and lake, and sky—and soul to me.

As used in the text, what does the word “breathes” most nearly mean?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
我是Ojistoh，我是她，是他的妻子/他的名字为部落注入了勇敢、生命和勇气，部落称他为酋长。/我是Ojistoh，他的白星，而他/是大地，是湖泊，是天空——是我的灵魂。
中文解析：
诗中“breathes”一词用于描述名字能够传递或赋予“勇敢、生命和勇气”，是一种拟人化表达，意为“注入”或“赋予”。因此，选项B“Imparts”（给予、赋予）最贴近文意。其他选项A“拒绝”、C“吸收”、D“默许”均不符合语境逻辑。

A student in an economics course is examining the decline since 1950 in average hours worked per person per year in various nations due to both increased productivity and the adoption of policies that limit working hours. The first task in this investigation is to determine how the decline in Switzerland compares to that in other countries. The student finds that ______

Which choice most effectively uses data from the table to complete the statement?
selections: A. though the percent decrease in hours worked in Switzerland was less than that in Germany, it was greater than that in Brazil and Japan.
B. the decline in number of hours worked was greater in Switzerland than it was in Germany, Brazil, or Japan.
C. while the number of hours worked rose in Switzerland from 1950 to 2017, it declined in Germany, Brazil, and Japan.
D. though the percent decrease in hours worked in Switzerland was greater than that in Germany and Japan, it was less than that in Brazil.
explanations:
某经济学课程学生正在研究各国自1950年以来因生产力提升和工作时长限制政策导致的人均年工作小时数下降现象。研究首要任务是确定瑞士的下降幅度与其他国家的对比情况。该学生发现______
中文解析：
根据表格数据，瑞士工作时长下降百分比为22%，介于德国的44%与巴西的16%、日本的14%之间。选项A准确表述了“瑞士降幅小于德国但大于巴西和日本”的对比关系。其他选项均存在数据错误：B项将绝对下降量与百分比混淆；C项误说瑞士工作时长上升；D项则完全颠倒了瑞士与巴西的百分比对比关系。

question:
Given the immense scope of space, the search for extraterrestrial life is almost necessarily concentrated on the exoplanets deemed to have the most plausible chance of success—typically, atmosphere-bearing terrestrial planets orbiting within a certain range of their stars (termed the habitable zone). Claiming that Earth experienced a long transition from single-lid to plate tectonics that accelerated the emergence and evolution of complex organisms, researchers Robert J. Stern and Taras V. Gerya hold that consideration of tectonics, an often overlooked factor, could help further narrow the search for advanced extraterrestrial species.

Based on the text, what do Stern and Gerya most likely believe about the development of complex life on exoplanets?
selections: A. It is more likely to occur on habitable zone planets with atmospheres and plate tectonics than on otherwise similar planets that lack plate tectonics.
B. It is more likely to occur if habitable zone planets with atmospheres transition from single-lid to plate tectonics late in their history than if they transition early in their history.
C. It is probably more dependent on the presence of plate tectonics than on orbital distance from a host star or the presence of an atmosphere.
D. It is unlikely unless the transition from single-lid to plate tectonics occurs before the acquisition of a lasting atmosphere.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
鉴于太空的浩瀚无垠，对外星生命的搜索几乎必然集中在被认为最有可能成功的系外行星上——通常是具有大气层、位于恒星宜居带内的类地行星。研究人员罗伯特·J·斯特恩和塔拉斯·V·格利亚声称，地球经历了从单层盖到板块构造的漫长过渡，这一过渡加速了复杂生物的出现和演化。他们认为，构造运动（一个常被忽视的因素）的考量可能有助于进一步缩小对高级外星物种的搜索范围。
中文解析：
斯特恩和格利亚指出，地球的板块构造过渡加速了复杂生命的演化，并建议在搜索外星生命时考虑构造运动以进一步缩小范围。因此，他们最可能认为：在有大气层和板块构造的宜居带行星上，复杂生命更可能发生，而非在类似但缺乏板块构造的行星上。选项A正确反映了这一观点。选项B涉及过渡时间，文本未提及；选项C夸大板块构造的重要性，文本仅强调其常被忽视；选项D设定条件关系，文本未支持。

question:
Zooarchaeologist Ophélie Lebrasseur and her team examined a fox skeleton discovered in 1991 at an archaeological site alongside artifacts of human habitation (like spear points) in central Argentina. Lebrasseur et al. determined that the fox was Dusicyon avus, an extinct species resembling a jackal, and radiocarbon dating placed the fox at the site at the same time as human inhabitants. (Indeed, the inhabitants may have deliberately buried the fox.) In addition, while wild foxes have a diet entirely made of meat, isotopic signatures of the skeleton’s teeth indicated that the fox’s diet, like that of the humans, was partly composed of plant material. Lebrasseur et al. therefore concluded that ________

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. the humans who were alive at the same time as the fox most likely ate more meat than the fox did.
B. the humans who were alive at the same time as the fox hunted using the spears whose points were also found at the site.
C. the fox may have been a companion animal of the humans who inhabited the site at the same time.
D. the fox had a diet more similar to that of jackals than to that of wild foxes.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
动物考古学家奥菲莉·勒布拉瑟及其团队研究了一具于1991年在阿根廷中部一处考古遗址发现的狐狸骨架，该遗址同时存在人类居住的遗物（如矛尖）。勒布拉瑟等人判定这只狐狸是已灭绝的“Dusicyon avus”物种，其形似豺狼，放射性碳定年显示这只狐狸与人类居民存在于同一时期（事实上，居民可能有意埋葬了这只狐狸）。此外，虽然野生狐狸的饮食全为肉类，但该骨架牙齿的同位素特征表明，这只狐狸与人类的饮食都部分由植物材料构成。勒布拉瑟等人因此得出结论：________
中文解析：
基于“与人类同时期”、“可能被人类有意埋葬”以及“其饮食与人类相似（包含植物）”等证据，最合理的推断是这只狐狸可能与人类存在某种互动关系，例如作为伴侣动物被人类驯养或共同生活。因此，选项C“这只狐狸可能是当时居住在该遗址的人类的伴侣动物”最符合逻辑。

Ratified in 2017 by two-thirds of World Trade Organization member nations, the Trade Facilitation Agreement (TFA) is a trade-reform measure that aims to reduce redundant customs procedures and other costly aspects of international trade. In a 2021 report, economist Jayson Beckman modeled global market prices of several agricultural commodities under both the TFA and an alternative trade-reform scenario: removal of agricultural tariffs (taxes on imports that generally increase prices on imported goods). After reviewing data from the report, a student concludes that overall, consumers of the commodities listed in the table would likely benefit more from the TFA than they would from tariff removal.

Which choice most effectively uses data from the table to support the student’s claim?
selections: A. Under the tariff-removal scenario, the average prices of processed foods, wheat, and fruits and vegetables would decrease by more than 1%, while the average price of rice would decrease by less than 1%.
B. Under the tariff-removal scenario, the average price of processed foods would increase, but the average prices of wheat and rice would decrease.
C. Under the TFA scenario, the average prices of all four commodities would decrease, whereas under the tariff-removal scenario, only the average price of processed foods would decrease.

D. Under the TFA scenario, the average price of rice would decrease by a smaller amount than any of the other three commodities’ prices would, whereas its average price would increase under the tariff-removal scenario.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在2017年，世界贸易组织三分之二的成员国批准了《贸易便利化协定》（TFA），这是一项旨在减少冗余海关程序和其他国际贸易中高成本因素的贸易改革措施。在2021年的一份报告中，经济学家贾森·贝克曼对在《贸易便利化协定》和另一种贸易改革情景（即取消农业关税，即通常会提高进口商品价格的进口税）下几种农产品的全球市场价格进行了建模。在审查了该报告的数据后，一位学生得出结论，整体而言，表中所列商品的消费者可能会比取消关税更能从《贸易便利化协定》中受益。
中文解析：
题目要求用表格数据支持学生的结论——消费者从《贸易便利化协定》（TFA）中获益比取消关税更多。TFA 情景：表格显示，所有四种商品（加工食品、小麦、水果蔬菜、大米）的平均价格全部下降，说明对消费者普遍有利。取消关税情景：只有加工食品价格下降，其他三种（小麦、水果蔬菜、大米）价格上升或降幅极小，对消费者好处有限。C 选项直接对比两种情景，证明 TFA 对消费者更有利，完全支持学生的结论。

question:
The Man-Made World: Or, Our Androcentric Culture is a 1911 nonfiction work by Charlotte Perkins Gilman. In the text, the author emphasizes the importance of cultivating individuals rather than comparing them: ________

Which quotation from The Man-Made World: Or, Our Androcentric Culture most effectively illustrates the claim?
selections: A. “That every child on earth shall have right conditions to make the best growth possible to it; that every citizen, from birth to death, shall have a chance to learn all he or she can [absorb], to develop everypower that is in them.”

B. “We do not sadly measure the cabbage-stalk by the corn-stalk, and praise the corn for getting ahead of the cabbage——nor incite the cabbage to [imitate] the corn. We nourish both, to its best growth—and are the richer.”
C. “We have but to learn the real elements in humanity; its true powers and natural characteristics.”
D. “We are now to consider the growth of the family in humanity.”
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
《人造世界：或，我们的男性中心文化》是夏洛特·珀金斯·吉尔曼于1911年出版的非虚构作品。在文中，作者强调培养个体而不是比较他们的重要性：________
中文解析：
选项B通过卷心菜和玉米的类比，明确表达了不应比较不同个体，而应滋养各自最佳生长的观点，直接且形象地说明了“培养个体而非比较”的主张。其他选项或侧重提供条件（A），或讨论人性要素（C），或偏离主题（D），均未直接体现“不比较”这一核心。

question:
Mastering ' ajami, a Syrian art of creating intricately painted wood panels, demands a skill set that ________ innate talent: crafting the panels requires not just the ability to draw but also an understanding of traditional techniques, materials, and design elements, necessitating expertise gained through dedicated guidance from experienced artisans.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
掌握 'ajami（一种叙利亚的绘制精细木板的艺术）需要的技能组合________天赋：制作木板不仅需要绘画能力，还需要理解传统工艺、材料和设计元素，必须通过经验丰富的工匠的悉心指导来获得专业知识。
中文解析：
根据后文解释，掌握'ajami不仅需要天赋，还需要后天学习的知识和技巧，因此技能组合“超越”了单纯的天赋。选项D“transcends”（超越）最符合逻辑，强调技能组合高于或超出天赋。A“限制”、B“复制”、C“以...为特征”均与语境不符。

question:
In what is now Washington state, the Tulalip Tribes operate the Hibulb Cultural Center. Relying on traditional knowledge to guide the design of exhibits, this institution presents Tulalip history and culture to the tribes’ citizens. The Turtle Mountain Band of Chippewa, a tribe in North Dakota, employs a similar strategy in its own cultural center. Both centers contrast with museums that aren’t Indigenous-led; when displaying Indigenous artifacts, such museums tend to anticipate mainly non-Indigenous audiences and rely on Euro-centric strategies for designing exhibits.

Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
selections: A. When staging Indigenous exhibits, non-Indigenous institutions should follow the example of the cultural centers operated by the Tulalip Tribes and the Turtle Mountain Band of Chippewa.
B. The cultural centers operated by the Tulalip Tribes and the Turtle Mountain Band of Chippewa differ in strategy from non-Indigenous museums that stage Indigenous exhibits.

C. Whereas non-Indigenous institutions stage exhibits on a wide array of subjects, the cultural centers operated by the Tulalip Tribes and the Turtle Mountain Band of Chippewa serve primarily to present Indigenous history and cultures.

D. The strategy used by the Tulalip Tribes to present history and culture to tribal citizens differs only slightly from the strategy used by the Turtle Mountain Band of Chippewa in its cultural center.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在现在的华盛顿州，图拉利普部落运营着希布尔布文化中心。该机构依靠传统知识指导展览设计，向部落公民展示图拉利普的历史和文化。北达科他州的奇佩瓦族龟山部落也在自己的文化中心采用了类似策略。这两个中心都与非原住民主导的博物馆形成对比；在展示原住民文物时，这类博物馆往往主要预期非原住民观众，并依赖以欧洲为中心的展览设计策略。
中文解析：
文本的核心是对比：两个原住民文化中心（都依靠传统知识、面向部落公民）与非原住民博物馆（预期非原住民观众、采用欧洲中心策略）在策展策略上的不同。因此，选项B准确概括了主要思想。

question:
The influence of William Shakespeare’s writings is clear in a vast range of subsequent literary works and is similarly ________ in many works in other media, from fine art (such as Edward Alcock’s painting Portia and Shylock) to popular music (such as the musician Elvis Costello’s song “Miss Macbeth”).

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
威廉·莎士比亚作品的影响在大量后世文学作品中显而易见，同样________ 地体现在许多其他媒介的作品中，从美术（如爱德华·阿尔科克的画作《鲍西娅与夏洛克》）到流行音乐（如音乐家埃尔维斯·科斯特洛的歌曲《麦克白夫人》）。
中文解析：
前半句指出莎士比亚的影响在文学作品中“clear”（明显），后半句以“similarly”（同样地）衔接，因此需选择与“clear”近义的词，强调影响的明显性。B项“apparent”（明显的）最符合逻辑，且与上下文精确对应。

question:
Despite potential independent confirmation, the apparent detection in 2020 of phosphine (PH3)—a gas that on Earth almost exclusively derives from biological sources—in Venus’s cloud deck remains controversial, in part because Venus is thought to be uninhabitable. To evaluate such a finding’s plausibility, William Bains et al. modeled multiple abiotic PH3 pathways, including geochemical, atmospheric, and photochemical reactions, but none adequately explain the observed levels of PH3 . If Venusian PH3 does exist, it would indicate insufficiencies in the current consensus on Venus’s chemistry.

Which choice best describes the overall structure of the text?
selections: A. It introduces an unexpected observation of a particular gas in Venus’s atmosphere, presents an effort to investigate possible mechanisms that could explain that observation, and then notes an implication of that investigation’s findings.

B. It explains why the consensus view of a particular gas in Venus’s atmosphere has recently become controversial, expands on a scientific team’s reasons for questioning that consensus, and then suggests that future observations of Venus’s atmosphere will likely be needed to settle the controversy.

C. It compares the levels of a particular gas on Venus and Earth, sketches the chemical processes that account for differences in these levels, and then addresses some of the practical challenges of studying the presence of this gas on Venus more closely.
D. It questions the effectiveness of the methods used to detect phosphine on Venus, proposes an alternative explanation for the data, and calls for a reevaluation of the planet’s habitability.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
尽管可能有独立的确认，2020年在金星云层中探测到磷化氢（PH3）——一种在地球上几乎完全来自生物来源的气体——仍然存在争议，部分原因是金星被认为不适合居住。为了评估这一发现的可能性，威廉·贝恩斯等人模拟了多种非生物PH3产生途径，包括地球化学、大气和光化学反应，但没有一种能充分解释观察到的PH3水平。如果金星PH3确实存在，它将表明当前对金星化学的共识存在不足。
中文解析：
文本首先引入金星大气中意外探测到磷化氢的争议性发现，接着描述研究团队为解释该发现而建模多种非生物途径的努力，最后指出若发现属实则意味着现有共识的不足。选项A准确概括了这一结构

question:
The Wonderful Wizard of Oz is a 1900 novel by L. Frank Baum. In the novel, Dorothy, who is from Kansas, finds herself in an unfamiliar place called Oz. Kansas is presented as being less appealing than Oz, as is clear when ________.

Which quotation from The Wonderful Wizard of Ozmost effectively illustrates the claim?
selections: A. a character says to Dorothy, “I cannot understand why you should wish to leave this beautiful country and go back to the dry, gray place you call Kansas.”
B. a character says to others, “But it will take more than imagination to carry Dorothy back to Kansas, and I’m sure I don’t know how it can be done.”

C. the narrator states, “Dorothy did not feel nearly so bad as you might think a little girl would who had been suddenly whisked away from her own country and set down in the midst of a strange land.”
D. the narrator states, “Before them was a great stretch of country having a floor as smooth and shining and white as the bottom of a big bowl.”
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
《绿野仙踪》是L. Frank Baum于1900年出版的小说。在小说中，来自堪萨斯的桃乐丝发现自己身处一个叫做奥兹的陌生地方。堪萨斯被描绘得不如奥兹有吸引力，这从________可以清楚看出。
中文解析：
题目要求选择引文来证明“堪萨斯不如奥兹有吸引力”。选项A通过角色之口直接对比了奥兹的“美丽”和堪萨斯的“干燥、灰色”，最能有效说明这一主张。选项B讨论如何带回桃乐丝，未涉及吸引力对比；选项C描述桃乐丝的感受，但未明确评价两地优劣；选项D不完整且仅描述奥兹风景，无关比较。

question:
In the nineteenth century, Elizabeth Cady Stanton and Susan B. Anthony ______ for women’s right to vote in the United States.

Which choice completes the text so that it corriforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 缺少谓语，只有B选项是正确的谓语形式

question:
While conducting an interview for her book Latina Authors and Their Muses, editor Mayra Calvani asked Sarah Cortez, author of the memoir Walking Home, what ________ Cortez’s response was Bury Me Deep by Megan Abbott.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: what引导宾语从句，引导词+主语+谓语是正确的语序

question:
A research team led by Gal Badihi has discovered that chimpanzees communicate through exchanges of gestures occurring at a pace similar to that of human conversations.________chimpanzee gesture exchanges have short pauses of about 120 milliseconds between communications, comparable to the 200-millisecond average pause between turns in human speech.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
由加尔·巴迪希领导的研究小组发现，黑猩猩通过交换手势进行交流，其节奏与人类对话相似。________，黑猩猩手势交流之间的间隔约为120毫秒，与人类对话中平均200毫秒的停顿相当。
中文解析：
前一句提到“节奏相似”，是一个总体发现；后一句用具体的停顿时长数据来具体说明这一相似性。因此，过渡词应表示“具体来说”或“精确而言”，所以选项A "Specifically," 最符合逻辑。

question:
In her Silueta sculpture series, the Cuban American artist Ana ________ to access what she called an “omnipresent female force,” utilized a variety of natural materials to create outlines—or silhouettes—of her own body.

Which choice completes the text so that it comforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: Ana Mendieta是句子主语，utilized 是句子谓语，中间的hoping to属于现在分词短语做插入语，前后逗号隔开

question:
As volcanologists like Tamsin Mather are apt to make clear, not all volcanoes are the same. Tendürek in Turkey, for example, is a shield volcano, a type of volcano named for its low profile, resembling a warrior’s shield lying on the ground. Opala in Russia, ________ is a caldera, a large cauldron-like hollow that forms shortly after the emptying of a magma chamber in a volcanic eruption.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
正如坦辛·马瑟等火山学家喜欢澄清的那样，并非所有火山都是一样的。例如，土耳其的Tendürek是一座盾状火山，这种火山因其低矮的外形而得名，类似于平放在地面上的盾牌。而俄罗斯的Opala，________是一座破火山口，即火山喷发后岩浆房排空不久形成的一种大锅状洼地。
中文解析：
前半句描述盾状火山，后半句描述破火山口，两者为不同类型的火山，形成对比关系。选项中仅有 B "in contrast,"（相比之下）能表达这种对比逻辑。

question:
The United Nations’ Trade and Development organization divides exports into five key categories: food items, agricultural materials, fuels, ores and raw metals, and manufactured goods (i.e., most nonfood goods made by machinery or by hand). In 2022, the majority (62 percent) of Belgium’s exports were manufactured goods.____ vaccines, medicines, and cars were its top exports.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
联合国贸易和发展组织将出口分为五大类：食品、农业原材料、燃料、矿石与金属原材料，以及制成品（即大多数由机器或手工制造的非食品类商品）。2022年，比利时出口的大部分（62%）是制成品。____，疫苗、药品和汽车是其最主要的出口产品。
中文解析：
前一句说“大部分出口是制成品”，后一句列举的疫苗、药品和汽车都属于“制成品”这一类别的具体例子。因此，过渡词应表示“在这个类别中”或“具体而言”，所以B选项"Within this category,"（在这一类别中）最符合逻辑。

question:
Choreographers George Balanchine and Martha Graham both contributed sections to the dance piece Episodes, which premiered at New York’s City Center of Music and Drama in 1959. This cross-genre collaboration brought together the distinct features of Balanchine’s neoclassical ballet and Graham’s modern _____ the stylistic diversity and creative innovation within the dance world.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 空前面是一个完整的句子，后面showcasing作为现在分词短语做后置定语，和前面用逗号隔开，所以选C

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
●The Great Salt Lake in Utah is one of the world’s saltiest bodies of water.
●The northern portion of the lake has a higher concentration of salt than the southern portion.
●Crustaceans called Artemia franciscana live in the southern portion.
●Bacteria called Nodularia live in the southern portion.

The student wants to emphasize a difference between Artemia franciscana and Nodularia. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Artemia franciscana are crustaceans that live in the southern portion of the Great Salt Lake.
B. Artemia franciscana and Nodularia both live in the Great Salt Lake’s southern portion.
C. The northern portion of the Great Salt Lake has a higher concentration of salt than does the southern portion.
D. Artemia franciscana and Nodularia are different types of organisms: Artemia franciscana are crustaceans, whereas Nodularia are bacteria.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在研究一个主题时，一名学生记录了以下笔记：
• 犹他州的大盐湖是世界上最咸的水体之一。
• 湖的北部比南部盐度更高。
• 一种名为“Artemia franciscana”的甲壳动物生活在湖的南部。
• 一种名为“Nodularia”的细菌生活在湖的南部。
中文解析：
笔记中明确指出“Artemia franciscana”是甲壳动物，而“Nodularia”是细菌，这是两者在生物类别上的根本区别。选项D直接说明了这一点，因此最有效地强调了二者的差异。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
●The cuneiform script is the earliest known set of symbols used for writing.
●Sumerian was one of the first languages to be written using the cuneiform script.
●Sumerian was a language in ancient Mesopotamia (present day Iraq).
●Clay tablets with Sumerian writing have been found there.
●Some of these tablets are almost 5,000 years old.

The student wants to identify a language that was written using the cuneiform script. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Examples of Mesopotamian writing that are nearly 5,000 years old have been found.
B. A language in ancient Mesopotamia used the cuneiform script for writing.
C. Clay tablets with cuneiform script have been found in present-day Iraq.
D. Sumerian, an ancient Mesopotamian language, was written using the cuneiform script.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在研究一个主题时，一名学生记录了以下笔记：
• 楔形文字是已知最早的一套书写符号。
• 苏美尔语是最早使用楔形文字书写的一种语言。
• 苏美尔语是古代美索不达米亚（今伊拉克）的一种语言。
• 那里发现了刻有苏美尔文字的泥板。
• 其中一些泥板有近5000年的历史。
中文解析：
问题要求明确指出“一种用楔形文字书写过的语言”。选项D “Sumerian, an ancient Mesopotamian language, was written using the cuneiform script.” 直接、完整地包含了“语言”和“用楔形文字书写”这两个关键信息，因此最有效。

question:
In the book A Theory of Harmony (1985), Swiss musicologist Ernst Levy argued that every chord has an opposite that can be substituted for it. For example, a pianist could replace the vi chord for the bill chord while __________ chord is a given chord’s opposite can be determined using a music visualization tool called the circle of fifths.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: a pianist could replace....improvising是第一个句子，which chord....the circle of fifths是第二个句子，两个句子之间用句号连接

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
●Extravehicular activities (EVAs) are activities performed outside a spacecraft by astronauts in outer space.
●EVAs are also known as spacewalks.
●Richard Mastracchio is a former US astronaut who has performed 9 spacewalks.
●The total time of Mastracchio’s spacewalks was 53 hours and 4 minutes.
●Garrett Reisman is a former US astronaut who has performed 3 spacewalks.
●The total time of Reisman’s spacewalks was 21 hours and 21 minutes.

The student wants to emphasize a similarity between the astronauts Mastracchio and Reisman. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Reisman has spent less time performing spacewalks than Mastracchio has.
B. EVAs, also known as spacewalks, are activities done by astronauts outside a spacecraft.
C. Mastracchio and Reisman have each performed multiple spacewalks.
D. Mastracchio has performed spacewalks, but Reisman has performed EVAs.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在研究一个主题时，一名学生记录了以下笔记：
• 舱外活动（EVAs）是宇航员在太空航天器外进行的活动。
• EVAs也被称为太空行走。
• 理查德·马斯特拉基奥是一位美国前宇航员，曾执行过9次太空行走。
• 马斯特拉基奥的太空行走总时长为53小时4分钟。
• 加勒特·赖斯曼是一位美国前宇航员，曾执行过3次太空行走。
• 赖斯曼的太空行走总时长为21小时21分钟。
中文解析：
笔记明确指出两位宇航员都曾执行过太空行走（舱外活动），这是他们的共同点。选项C “Mastracchio and Reisman have each performed multiple spacewalks.” 直接说明了他们都执行过多次太空行走，最有效地强调了这一相似之处。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
●The Tijuana Slough National Wildlife Refuge (NWR) is a protected natural area in California.
●It encompasses 1,023 acres.
●The Tijuana Slough NWR was established to safeguard the habitat of the light-footed clapper rail, an endangered species.
●The Tijuana Slough NWR is managed by the US Fish & Wildlife Service.
●The US Fish & Wildlife Service limits human activities in the area.

The student wants to emphasize the role the US Fish & Wildlife Service plays in safeguarding the habitat of the light-footed clapper rail. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. By limiting human activities in the Tijuana Slough NWR, the US Fish & Wildlife Service safeguards the habitat of the light-footed clapper rail.
B. Human activities are limited in the Tijuana Slough NWR, a protected natural area in California.
C. Home to the light-footed clapper rail, the Tijuana Slough NWR is located in California, where it encompasses 1,023 acres.
D. The 1,023-acre Tijuana Slough NWR was established to safeguard the habitat of the light-footed clapper rail, an endangered species.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在研究一个主题时，一名学生记录了以下笔记：
• 蒂华纳河国家野生动物保护区是加利福尼亚州的一个受保护的自然区域。
• 它占地1,023英亩。
• 蒂华纳河国家野生动物保护区的建立是为了保护濒危物种“轻足秧鸡”的栖息地。
• 蒂华纳河国家野生动物保护区由美国鱼类及野生动物管理局管理。
• 美国鱼类及野生动物管理局限制该区域的人类活动。
中文解析：
笔记明确指出该保护区由美国鱼类及野生动物管理局管理，且其措施是“限制人类活动”，目标是为了保护轻足秧鸡的栖息地。选项A将这三点信息（管理者、具体措施、保护目标）直接联系，最有效地强调了该机构在保护栖息地中的直接作用和角色。

question:
The following text is from Charles Dickens’s 1861 novel Great Expectations. The narrator is taking a walk near his home on a damp morning.
On every rail and gate, wet lay clammy, and the marsh mist was so thick, that the wooden finger on the post directing people to our village—a direction which they never accepted, for they never came there—was invisible to me until I was quite close under it.

As used in the text, what does the word “accepted” most nearly mean?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
查尔斯·狄更斯1861年小说《远大前程》选段。叙述者在一个潮湿的早晨在家附近散步。
"每一条栏杆和门上都湿漉漉地附着湿气，沼泽的雾气如此浓重，以至于杆子上指示人们前往我们村子的木制指路牌——一个他们从未______的方向，因为他们从未来过那里——直到我走到它正下方才看见。"
答案解析：
"accepted"在此语境中指人们从未"遵循"或"采纳"路牌指引的方向前往村庄。选项中的"followed"（遵循）最贴近此处的逻辑：路牌指示方向，但他们从未按此方向行进。其他选项"shifted"（改变）、"approved"（批准）、"authorized"（授权）均不符合"接受并遵循指引"的语义。

question:

Armin Granulo and colleagues, however, found that for products with higher symbolic value (those viewed as contributing to individual self-expression), consumers prefer products made by humans rather than by robots, likely because human-made products are more strongly associated with uniqueness. When considering automation, therefore, companies—especially those specializing in products of symbolic value—should weigh trade-offs between efficiency gains and consumer preferences.

B. It emphasizes that a research finding discussed in the text has practical implications that are particularly relevant for businesses making a certain class of product.
C. It presents evidence supporting the text’s argument that consumers prefer products with high symbolic value over products with low symbolic value.
